Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" No. 30 (47) Jan. 29 and 31, 1920

arrests in Harbin.

In connection with the discovery of a plot of railway men and labour unions chiefs in Harbin, meetings of protest are being held in the interior, of several cities, against the outrages committed by the Chinese authorities. The following outcries were heard:- "The policy of the supreme head of labour organizations and oppression of the working classes is a dangerous game". "Let nobody forget that the Chinese Eastern Railway is a joint concern of the two nations". "We demand immediate release of representatives of labour unions of ... etc. etc."

At a meeting held and attended by Chinese labourers Comrade Li-Shan informed the attendance of the proceedings in Harbin in the terms as under:-

"These militarists are starting a bad business. They have already attacked the Harbin telephone station, and by armed force are arresting leaders of labour unions. Moreover they stop all traffic on the railway by armed force with a view to suppressing us, labourers. We protest against this policy of the Chinese militarists carried on on the same lines as the policy of ... Again, they will lose in the end. Their actions are unacceptable to the masses of the Chinese people. Let them cease their abuses before it is too late!"

At another meeting the following was said:- "In view of recent dates in China and on the ... we must prepare with increased energy for a decisive encounter with the plunderers- imperialists and their hirelings the Chinese militarists. We wish to assure the Chinese Labour Party that we are ever ready to follow its call and to turn our weapons against the imperialists and the Chinese Generals, who are not ashamed to accept the blood money of the foreign oppressors from the Chinese labourers, who are waiting for a signal to march under Lenin's banners and fight the battles of labour versus capital."

Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) February ...

Patriot Soviet Conference.

At the III Soviet of Vladivostok District Conference Comrade ... speaking of the international situation stated the following:- "Revolutionary activity of the masses is growing every succeeding day and much progress is made. Also, with what the hatred of imperialistic countries against the Soviets is increasing too. We do not forget in our daily life duties the will expressed by Lenin vis the attainment of a world wide revolution.

A delegation from Chinese labourers, speaking in the name of one thousand two hundred men residing in Vladivostock, assured the Conference that Chinese would fight shoulder to shoulder with their Russian comrades for the socialistic construction of Vladivostock district. They added that although Chinese generals wanted to interfere with peaceful construction of life, they were ready to enter into opposition with the enemy.

Copies for authorities attached.
H.R.M Commr.
Col. Mallam
Majd. Cavan
Capt. Sheehy. G.S.
H. Robertson
W.B. 21.2.'24

译自1920年1月29日及31日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）第30期（47号）

哈尔滨的逮捕行动。

鉴于在哈尔滨发现铁路工人和工会领袖的阴谋，内地数个城市正在举行抗议集会，反对中国当局所犯下的暴行。现场听到以下呼声：“劳工组织最高领导人的政策以及对工人阶级的压迫是一种危险的游戏”。“谁也不要忘记，中东铁路是两国的合资企业”。“我们要求立即释放……等工会代表”等等。

在一次有中国工人参加的集会上，李山同志向与会者通报了哈尔滨的事态发展，内容如下：

“这些军阀正在干坏事。他们已经袭击了哈尔滨电话局，并动用武力逮捕工会领导人。此外，他们还以武力阻断铁路交通，企图镇压我们这些工人。我们抗议中国军阀的这种政策，其行径与……的政策如出一辙。他们最终必将失败。他们的行为为中国广大民众所不容。让他们在为时已晚之前停止滥用职权！”

在另一次集会上，有人发言称：“鉴于中国近期及……的局势，我们必须以更充沛的精力准备与掠夺者——帝国主义者及其走狗中国军阀进行决定性交锋。我们要向中国劳动党保证，我们随时准备响应其号召，将武器对准帝国主义者和那些中国将军，他们毫不羞耻地接受外国压迫者从中国工人身上榨取的血汗钱，而工人们正等待信号，以便在列宁的旗帜下行进，开展劳工对抗资本的斗争。”

译自《红旗报》（Red Banner）2月……

爱国苏维埃会议。

在海参崴地区苏维埃第三次代表大会上，……同志在谈到国际形势时指出：“群众的革命活动日益增长，取得了很大进展。同时，帝国主义国家对苏维埃的仇恨也在增加。我们在日常工作中没有忘记列宁关于实现世界革命的意愿。

一个由中国工人组成的代表团，代表居住在海参崴的一千二百名工人向大会保证，中国人将与他们的俄罗斯同志并肩作战，为海参崴地区的社会主义建设而奋斗。他们补充说，虽然中国将军们试图干扰和平的生活建设，但他们已准备好与敌人进行对抗。

附呈当局副本。
H.R.M Commr.
Mallam 上校
Cavan 少校
Sheehy 上尉 G.S.

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya"(Red Banner) Dec. 27, 1928.

German seamen celebrate Christmas Eve
on Soviet principles.

S. S, "Ilmar", a German ship, happened to be in port
at Vladivostock on Christmas Eve. The Crew were provided
with a packet of apples and some nuts each by the Command.
The seamen made fun of these gifts and went to celebrate
the occasion at the Soviet International Club. The men
decided that being in Soviet country they should celebrate
in Soviet style. On arriving at the Club they participated
with other communists in the anti-religious ceremony held there.
Then they joined the Russian comrades in singing and music
including the rendering of the "Internationale!"

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya"(Red Banner) Dec.30, 1928.

After II years of French Custody.

I. I. Alpatoff, who has returned to Vladivostock after
having spent II years in French custody and hard labour, at
the time of Revolution in 1917 was in France with other Russian
army men and was not allowed to proceed to Russia because
of the Bolsheviks there at the time. The Russian soldiers
revolted then and their uprising was very severely suppressed
with the result that a great many were killed and the rest
were taken prisoners. They first served in the prison of Lyons
for a year and 3 months and were later sent to Africa and
placed on hard labour. Treatment and food of prisoners was
very bad until 1921 when supplies were forwarded from Soviet
Russia. In 1928 105 men including Alpatoff escaped to Morocco
and were kindly treated by the natives, who assisted the
fugitives to communicate with the Soviet Consulate who took
charge of them. In October 1928 Alpatoff reached Soviet
territory and proceeded to the Far East, which is his home.

Movement to improve the position of Eastern workers.

The Central Committee of the Mines workers Union has
adopted a number of resolutions to protect the interests of
Chinese and Japanese workers employed in mines in the Far
East. Information to hand is to the effect that Eastern
workers are worse off than Russian and often labour legislation
bye laws are not applied as they should to the Eastern workers.
The Committee advises the local committees in the Far East
to remedy this state of affairs. Improvement in the position
of Eastern workers is consequently expected shortly.

International politics. Weekly Review.

Prior to the disturbances in Afghanistan a Colonel
of the British General Staff visited the Afghan-Indian
border, being a messenger of the Ministry for Foreign Affairs
or War. His task was to examine the forts on the border. This
mission of the Colonel is closely connected with the subsequent
happenings in Afghanistan. One of the main problems of
Amanullah Han was to make Afghanistan independent , but this
naturally caused discontent in the reactionary circles of
Great Britain, which is accustomed to regard Afghanistan as its
colony. There is undoubtedly a connection between the reactio-
nary movement in Afghanistan and London, authorities representing
which are certain to be guiding the movement. British
imperialists are, however, bent on interfering in the affairs
of Afghanistan and provocation on their part may be expected
at any time which will result in military intervention.

译自1928年12月27日《红旗报》（Red Banner）。

德国海员按照苏维埃原则庆祝平安夜。

德国船只“Ilmar”号适逢平安夜停泊在海参崴港。船方给每位船员分发了一包苹果和一些坚果。海员们对这些礼物嗤之以鼻，转而前往苏维埃国际俱乐部庆祝这一节日。大家决定，既然身在苏维埃国家，就应按苏维埃方式庆祝。到达俱乐部后，他们与其他共产主义者一起参加了在那里举行的反宗教仪式。随后，他们与俄罗斯同志一起唱歌奏乐，其中包括演唱《国际歌》！

译自1928年12月30日《红旗报》（Red Banner）。

经过两年的法国监禁。

I. I. Alpatoff 在法国被监禁并服苦役两年后返回海参崴。1917年革命发生时，他与其他俄国军人一起在法国，因当时俄国有布尔什维克而不被允许返回俄国。俄国士兵随即发动兵变，起义遭到严厉镇压，导致许多人被杀，其余人被俘。他们首先在里昂监狱服刑一年零三个月，后来被送往非洲服苦役。囚犯的待遇和食物非常糟糕，直到1921年从苏维埃俄罗斯运来物资为止。1928年，包括 Alpatoff 在内的105人逃往摩洛哥，受到当地人的善待，当地人协助逃亡者与苏维埃领事馆取得联系，领事馆随后接管了他们。1928年10月，Alpatoff 抵达苏维埃领土，并前往他的家乡远东。

改善东方工人地位的运动。

煤矿工人工会中央委员会通过了一系列决议，以保护在远东矿山工作的中国和日本工人的利益。现有资料显示，东方工人的处境比俄罗斯工人更差，劳动立法细则往往未能按规定适用于东方工人。委员会建议远东地方委员会纠正这种状况。因此，预计东方工人的地位不久将得到改善。

国际政治。每周评论。

在阿富汗发生骚乱之前，一名英国总参谋部上校访问了阿富汗-印度边境，他是外交部或战争部的信使。他的任务是检查边境上的堡垒。这位上校的任务与随后在阿富汗发生的事件密切相关。阿曼努拉汗（Amanullah Han）的主要问题之一是使阿富汗独立，但这自然引起了英国反动阶层的不满，因为英国习惯于将阿富汗视为其殖民地。阿富汗的反动运动与伦敦之间无疑存在联系，伦敦当局肯定在指导这一运动。然而，英国帝国主义者决心干涉阿富汗事务，随时可能由其挑衅引发军事干预。

page_data.en:
Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of Nov. II, 1923. (Vladivostock)

A. Marti sends greetings to the proletariat of the Far East.

Dear Brethren,
On the IIth anniversary of October Revolution my thoughts go back to the terrible days of November 1917 when the labourers and peasants of Germany and France were killing one another in the general massacre in order to increase the resources of their exploiters.
In France where the Minister Penlevè suppressed in a most cruel manner uprisings at the Front and where Clemenceau established his iron dictatorship, the news of the October Revolution was very timely so as to arouse the enthusiasm of the revolutionary movement. The menace of another war is over our heads now. Chauvinists in all countries of the Capital are very active again.
The French Bourgeoisie, whose militarism is stronger than ever, has joined the anti-Soviet block and wealthy Bank and industrial circles like hungry wolves are awaiting the start of a campaign against U.S.S.R. with great hopes to make large profits.
This time, millions of labourers will rise up in Germany, France and other countries desiring peace, to overthrow the capitalistic form of government, founded on exploitation and blood-shed.
My comradely greetings to all warriors of the Revolutionary Red Front, side by side with whom we shall march to victory over capitalism, militarism and fascism.
                                Jd. A. Marti
                     Santé Prison, October II, 1923.

Anti-Japanese movement in China.

The anti-Japanese movement in China has assumed of late dimensions which cannot be altogether disregarded by the Japanese Government. The prolonged boycott of Japanese goods in China has resulted in the relations between the two countries becoming more tense. Recently the boycott was strengthened by another serious movement that of a protest against the building by Japan of railways in Manchuria. It is a well known fact that the construction of railways is for any Government of imperialistic tendencies the surest way of getting into the centre of the country concerned with a view to establishing a hold on it. There is no doubt that the extension of railway lines by Japan is meant as a means to subjugate Manchuria as an important market for raw materials so necessary to uphold Japanese interests. The Chinese Press is unanimous in protesting the construction of the railways by Japan. The population of Three Eastern Provinces is also supporting the protest. In Harbin demonstrations were held to show opposition to Japan.
Along with the growth of anti-Japanese movement there is a marked tendency towards Sino-American unification. The tactics of the Nanking Government is not only to involve American business circles to co-operate with China but goes even as far as wanting to establish a certain political contact with Washington. In the face of Sino-Japanese misunderstandings, this policy of Nanking should be attentively watched as it seems to indicate that stress will be laid upon former Japanese-American disagreements over the Pacific Coast in the pursuit of new relations.
page_data.zh:
译自1923年11月11日《红旗报》（海参崴）。

A. Marti 向远东无产阶级致意。

亲爱的同志们，
在十月革命十一周年之际，我的思绪回到了1917年11月那些可怕的日子，当时德国和法国的工人与农民在大规模屠杀中互相残杀，以增加其剥削者的资源。
在法国，潘勒韦（Penlevè）部长以最残酷的方式镇压前线的起义，克列孟梭（Clemenceau）建立了铁腕独裁统治，十月革命的消息及时传来，激发了革命运动的热情。另一场战争的威胁如今笼罩在我们头顶。资本主义各国的沙文主义者再次活跃起来。
法国资产阶级，其军国主义比以往任何时候都强大，已加入反苏维埃集团，而富有的银行和工业界人士则像饿狼一样，怀着获取巨额利润的巨大希望，等待着对苏联发起战役的开始。
这一次，德国、法国和其他国家的数百万渴望和平的工人将奋起推翻建立在剥削和流血基础上的资本主义政府形式。
我向革命红色前线的所有战士致以同志般的问候，我们将与他们并肩行进，直至战胜资本主义、军国主义和法西斯主义。
                                Jd. A. Marti
                     桑泰监狱，1923年10月11日。

中国的反日运动。

中国的反日运动最近已达到日本政府不能完全忽视的规模。中国长期抵制日货导致两国关系更加紧张。最近，抵制运动因另一场严重运动而加强，即抗议日本在满洲修建铁路。众所周知，对于任何具有帝国主义倾向的政府来说，修建铁路是进入相关国家中心地带并确立控制的最可靠途径。毫无疑问，日本扩展铁路线意在将满洲作为维持日本利益所必需的重要原材料市场加以征服。中国报刊一致抗议日本修建铁路。东三省民众也支持这一抗议。在哈尔滨，举行了示威活动以表示反对日本。
随着反日运动的发展，中美联合的趋势日益明显。南京政府的策略不仅是让美国商界与中国合作，甚至希望与华盛顿建立某种政治接触。面对中日误解，应密切关注南京的这一政策，因为它似乎表明，在追求新关系的过程中，将强调以前美日在太平洋沿岸的分歧。

page_data.en:
The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) translation of Nov. 16, 1928.

Women of the East.

Women of the East are generally slaves to their husbands
and otherwise. They are most humiliated and backward in every
respect of all women in the world. In Soviet Russia, however,
things are different for women of the East. In Vladivostock for
instance about 1800 Korean women attend meetings. These women are
aged about 20 to 25 on an average. They take an active part
in Soviet affairs and a certain percentage even participates
in village elections, etc. In the former Russia Korean women
were oppressed and now they enjoy equal rights and privileges
with the man irrespective of their nationality and help to build
up the Soviet country There is a Korean woman in the District
Committee, over hundred women are members of the Communist Party,
about a thousand and a half are members of the Union of Communistic
Youth and in the People's Committee there are 12 Korean women.
The case of the Chinese women is slightly worse. The Chinese
customs are very conservative and Soviet reforms take time to
make a change amidst them, but even here improvements are gradually
showing. Afraid of the severe Soviet laws slave traders are more
careful in importing Chinese women from Shanghai to work in
brothels at Vladivostock. Husbands too ill-treat their wives in a
lesser degree as the latter can apply for protection to Court.
15 Chinese women are delegates at meetings and also take up other
activities as time goes on. There is a great deal more to be done
to obtain freedom for women of the East, but the Soviet Government
is promoting equality for both men and women workers including
all nationalities.

Anti-religious propaganda amongst Koreans.

The Korean Section of the District Committee is about to
introduce certain measures for promoting anti-religious
propaganda amongst Koreans. Anti-religious organizations have
been instructed to increase their activities.

A/D. C. I.

译自1928年11月16日《红旗报》（Red Banner）。

东方妇女。

东方妇女通常是丈夫等的奴隶。她们是世界上所有妇女中最受屈辱和最落后的。然而，在苏维埃俄罗斯，东方妇女的情况有所不同。例如，在海参崴，约有1800名朝鲜妇女参加会议。这些妇女平均年龄约为20至25岁。她们积极参与苏维埃事务，一定比例的人甚至参与村庄选举等。在前俄罗斯，朝鲜妇女受到压迫，现在她们享有与男子平等的权利和特权，不论其国籍如何，并帮助建设苏维埃国家。区委会中有一名朝鲜妇女，一百多名妇女是共产党员，约一千五百人是共产主义青年团成员，人民委员会中有12名朝鲜妇女。中国妇女的情况稍差一些。中国习俗非常保守，苏维埃改革需要时间才能在其中产生变化，但即使在这里，改善也在逐渐显现。由于害怕严厉的苏维埃法律，人口贩子在从上海进口中国妇女到海参崴妓院工作时变得更加谨慎。丈夫虐待妻子的程度也较轻，因为妻子可以向法院寻求保护。15名中国妇女是会议代表，并随着时间的推移参与其他活动。为争取东方妇女的自由还有很多工作要做，但苏维埃政府正在促进包括所有民族在内的男女工人平等。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya"(Red Banner) Dec. 27, 1928.

German seamen celebrate Christmas Eve
on Soviet principles.

S. S. "Ilmar", a German ship, happened to be in port
at Vladivostock on Christmas Eve. The Crew were provided
with a packet of apples and some nuts each by the Command.
The seamen made fun of these gifts and went to celebrate
the occasion at the Soviet International Club. The men
decided that being in Soviet country they should celebrate
in Soviet style. On arriving at the Club they participated
with other communists in the anti-religious ceremony held there.
Then they joined the Russian comrades in singing and music
including the rendering of the "Internationale"

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya"( Red Banner ) Dec.30, 1928.

After 11 years of French Custody.

I. I. Alpatoff, who has returned to Vladivostock after
having spent 11 years in French custody and hard labour, at
the time of Revolution in 1917 was in France with other Russian
army men and was not allowed to proceed to Russia because
of the Bolsheviks there at the time. The Russian soldiers
revolted then and their uprising was very severely suppressed
with the result that a great many were killed and the rest
were taken prisoners. They first served in the prison of Lyons
for a year and 3 months and were later sent to Africa and
placed on hard labour. Treatment and food of prisoners was
very bad until 1921 when supplies were forwarded from Soviet
Russia. In 1923 106 men including Alpatoff escaped to Morocco
and were kindly treated by the natives, who assisted the
fugitives to communicate with the Soviet Consulate who took
charge of them. In October 1928 Alpatoff reached Soviet
territory and proceeded to the Far East, which is his home.

Movement to improve the position of Eastern workers.

The Central Committee of the Mines Workers Union has
adopted a number of resolutions to protect the interests of
Chinese and Japanese workers employed in mines in the Far
East. Information to hand is to the effect that Eastern
workers are worse off than Russian and often labour legislation
by laws are not applied as they should to the Eastern workers.
The Committee advises the local committees in the Far East
to remedy this state of affairs. Improvement in the position
of Eastern workers is consequently expected shortly.

International politics. Weekly Review.

Prior to the disturbances in Afghanistan a Colonel
of the British General Staff visited the Afghan-Indian
border, being a messenger of the Ministry for Foreign Affairs
or War. His task was to examine the forts on the border. This
mission of the Colonel is closely connected with the subsequent
happenings in Afghanistan. One of the main problems of
Amanullah: Han was to make Afghanistan independent , but this
naturally caused discontent in the reactionary circles of
Great Britain, which is accustomed to regard Afghanistan as its
colony. There is undoubtedly a connection between the reactio-
nary movement in Afghanistan and London, authorities representing
which are certain to be guiding the movement. British
imperialists are, however, bent on interfering in the affairs
of Afghanistan and provocation on their part may be expected
at any time which will result in military intervention.

译自1928年12月27日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

德国海员按照苏维埃原则庆祝平安夜。

德国船只“伊尔马”号（S. S. "Ilmar"）恰逢平安夜停泊在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）港。船方给每位船员分发了一包苹果和一些坚果。海员们对这些礼物嗤之以鼻，转而前往苏维埃国际俱乐部庆祝这一节日。大家决定，既然身处苏维埃国家，就应当以苏维埃的方式庆祝。抵达俱乐部后，他们与其他共产主义者一起参加了在那里举行的反宗教仪式。随后，他们与俄国同志一起唱歌奏乐，其中包括演唱《国际歌》。

译自1928年12月30日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

经过11年的法国监禁。

I. I. Alpatoff（音译）在法国被监禁并服苦役11年后返回符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。1917年革命发生时，他与其他俄国军人一起在法国，因当时俄国有布尔什维克，不被允许返回俄国。俄国士兵随即发动起义，但遭到极其严厉的镇压，导致许多人被杀，其余人被俘。他们首先在里昂监狱服刑一年三个月，后来被送往非洲服苦役。囚犯的待遇和食物非常糟糕，直到1921年苏维埃俄国运送补给品后才有所改善。1923年，包括Alpatoff在内的106人逃往摩洛哥，受到当地居民的善待，居民协助逃亡者与接管他们的苏维埃领事馆取得联系。1928年10月，Alpatoff抵达苏维埃领土，并前往其家乡远东地区。

改善东方工人地位的运动。

矿工工会中央委员会通过了一系列决议，以保护受雇于远东矿山的中国和日本工人的利益。现有资料显示，东方工人的处境比俄国工人更差，劳动立法往往未能如应然地适用于东方工人。委员会建议远东地方委员会纠正这种状况。因此，预计东方工人的地位不久将得到改善。

国际政治。每周评论。

在阿富汗发生骚乱之前，英国总参谋部的一名上校访问了阿富汗-印度边境，他是外交部或战争部的信使。他的任务是检查边境上的堡垒。这名上校的使命与随后在阿富汗发生的事件密切相关。阿曼努拉汗（Amanullah Han）面临的主要问题之一是使阿富汗独立，但这自然引起了英国反动阶层的不满，因为英国习惯于将阿富汗视为其殖民地。阿富汗的反动运动与伦敦当局之间无疑存在联系，后者肯定在指导这一运动。然而，英国帝国主义者执意干涉阿富汗事务，随时可能进行挑衅，从而导致军事干预。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of Nov. 11, 1928. (Vladivostock)

A. Marti sends greetings to the proletariat of the Far East.

Dear Brethren,
On the 11th anniversary of October Revolution my thoughts go back to the terrible days of November 1917 when the labourers and peasants of Germany and France were killing one another in the general massacre in order to increase the resources of their exploiters.
In France where the Minister Penlevè suppressed in a most cruel manner uprisings at the Front and where Clemenceau established his iron dictatorship, the news of the October Revolution was very timely so as to arouse the enthusiasm of the revolutionary movement. The menace of another war is over our heads now. Chauvinists in all countries of the Capital are very active again.
The French Bourgeoisie, whose militarism is stronger than ever, has joined the anti-Soviet block and wealthy Bank and Industrial circles like hungry wolves are awaiting the start of a campaign against U.S.S.R. with great hopes to make large profits.
This time, millions of labourers will rise up in Germany, France and other countries desiring peace, to overthrow the capitalistic form of government, founded on exploitation and blood-shed.
My comradely greetings to all warriors of the Revolutionary Red Front, side by side with whom we shall march to victory over capitalism, militarism and fascism.
Sd. A. Marti
Santé Prison, October 11, 1928.

Anti-Japanese movement in China.

The anti-Japanese movement in China has assumed of late dimensions which cannot be altogether disregarded by the Japanese Government. The prolonged boycott of Japanese goods in China has resulted in the relations between the two countries becoming more tense. Recently the boycott was strengthened by another serious movement that of a protest against the building by Japan of railways in Manchuria. It is a well known fact that the construction of railways is for any Government of imperialistic tendencies the surest way of getting into the centre of the country concerned with a view to establishing a hold on it. There is no doubt that the extension of railway lines by Japan is meant as a means to subjugate Manchuria as an important market for raw materials so necessary to uphold Japanese interests. The Chinese Press is unanimous in protesting the construction of the railways by Japan. The population of Three Eastern Provinces is also supporting the protest. In Harbin demonstrations were held to show opposition to Japan.
Along with the growth of anti-Japanese movement there is a marked tendency towards Sino-American unification. The tactics of the Nanking Government is not only to involve American business circles to co-operate with China but goes even as far as wanting to establish a certain political contact with Washington. In the face of Sino-Japanese misunderstandings, this policy of Nanking should be attentively watched as it seems to indicate that stress will be laid upon former Japanese-American disagreements over the Pacific Coast in the pursuit of new relations.

译自1928年11月11日《红旗报》（符拉迪沃斯托克/海参崴）。

A. Marti（音译）向远东无产阶级致意。

亲爱的同志们：
在十月革命十一周年之际，我的思绪回到了1917年11月那些可怕的日子，当时德国和法国的劳工与农民为了增加剥削者的资源而在大屠杀中互相残杀。
在法国，潘勒韦（Penlevè）部长以最残酷的方式镇压前线的起义，克列孟梭（Clemenceau）建立了他的铁腕独裁统治，此时十月革命的消息非常及时，足以激起革命运动的热情。另一场战争的威胁如今正笼罩在我们头顶。各国资本家中的沙文主义者再次活跃起来。
法国资产阶级的军国主义比以往任何时候都强大，已加入反苏维埃集团，而像饿狼一样的富裕银行和工业界人士正怀着获取巨额利润的巨大希望，等待着对苏联发起运动的开始。
这一次，德国、法国和其他国家的数百万渴望和平的劳动者将奋起推翻建立在剥削和流血基础上的资本主义政府形式。
我向革命红色战线的所有战士致以同志般的问候，我们将与他们并肩行进，直至战胜资本主义、军国主义和法西斯主义。
签名：A. Marti
桑泰监狱（Santé Prison），1928年10月11日。

中国的反日运动。

中国的反日运动最近已达到日本政府不能完全忽视的规模。中国长期抵制日货导致两国关系更加紧张。最近，另一次严重的运动——抗议日本在满洲修建铁路——加强了抵制力度。众所周知，对于任何具有帝国主义倾向的政府来说，修建铁路是进入相关国家中心地带并试图控制该国的最可靠方式。毫无疑问，日本扩展铁路线旨在将满洲征服为维持日本利益所必需的重要原材料市场。中国报刊一致抗议日本修建铁路。东三省民众也支持这一抗议。在哈尔滨，举行了示威活动以表示反对日本。
随着反日运动的发展，中美联合的趋势日益明显。南京政府的策略不仅是让美国商界与中国合作，甚至希望与华盛顿建立某种政治联系。面对中日误解，南京的这一政策值得密切关注，因为它似乎表明，在追求新关系的过程中，将强调以前美日在太平洋沿岸的分歧。

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) translation of Nov. 16, 1928.

Women of the East.

Women of the East are generally slaves to their husbands
and otherwise. They are most humiliated and backward in every
respect of all women in the world. In Soviet Russia, however,
things are different for women of the East. In Vladivostock for
instance about 1300 Korean women attend meetings. These women are
aged about 20 to 25 on an average. They take an active part
in Soviet affairs and a certain percentage even participates
in village elections, etc. In the former Russia Korean women
were oppressed and now they enjoy equal rights and privileges
with the men irrespective of their nationality and help to build
up the Soviet country There is a Korean woman in the District
Committee, over hundred women are members of the Communist Party,
about a thousand and a half are members of the Union of Communistic
Youth and in the People's Committee there are 12 Korean women.
The case of the Chinese women is slightly worse. The Chinese
customs are very conservative and Soviet reforms take time to
make a change amidst them, but even here improvements are gradually
showing. Afraid of the severe Soviet laws slave traders are more
careful in importing Chinese women from Shanghai to work in
brothels at Vladivostock. Husbands too ill-treat their wives in a
lesser degree as the latter can apply for protection to court.
15 Chinese women are delegates at meetings and also take up other
activities as time goes on. There is a great deal more to be done
to obtain freedom for women of the East, but the Soviet government
is promoting equality for both men and women workers including
all nationalities.

Anti-religious propaganda amongst Koreans.

The Korean section of the District Committee is about to
introduce certain measures for promoting anti-religious
propaganda amongst Koreans. Anti-religious organizations have
been instructed to increase their activities.

A/D. C. 1.

Translation of "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) January 9, 1929.

Afganistan disturbances.

Afghan newspaper "Ania" writes:- "For the past several days the British aeroplanes fly over the city of Kabul and throw down various handbills. The population is indignant at the behaviour of the British who during the past ten years are setting up fortifications on the border of Afganistan. We know that every action of the British is directed against us". The newspaper likewise expresses indignation at the rioters being called "religious organizations" by the British in their appeal. Calling the rioters thus means making things worse. It also means that the British are insulting, humiliating and interfering with the people. If such action on the part of the British does not cease, it will be just to assert that the British are seeking to interfere by force of arms into affairs of Afghanistan. India is sympathising with Afghanistan.

The death of Grand Duke.

With reference to the above the "Krasnoe Znamya" states that "there is one White bandit less in the world".

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) January 10, 1929.

England's designs on Thibet.

Shanghai 8 (Tass) In connection with the proposed Conference to deal with the questions of "Defence of China's Borders" the newspaper "Shun Pao" advocates that the Nanking Government should give special attention to Thibet, on which England is trying to impose her economic influence". The newspaper adds that the British representatives are insisting before the Thibetan Authorities to proclaim Thibet's independence promising them financial and military assistance.

Labour Unions in Harbin and dismissal of Soviet employees.

The Harbin Chinese newspaper "Gun Pao" wrote two articles protesting against the existence of labour unions in which Soviet citizens and employees are members. The paper asserts that as a result of these unions industry in North Manchuria has suffered because there was too much pressure on the industrial concerns to improve labour conditions.
Lately there have been a great many dismissals of Soviet citizens from various concerns, schools and organizations.

Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) January 11, 1929.

Millions of starving and millions of well-fed.
A letter from London.

Lord Birkenhead is the famous leader of the British and former President of the House of Lords. His name is appearing to-day on the sign-boards of many large British Trading and Industrial Concerns. It is a splendid advertisement that of the Statesman and former President of the House of Lords. It is worth paying several thousand a month for such an advertisement. It is paid too and the Lord receives the money. He is however not satisfied with that. It is not "sufficient" for him. The question came up recently and was favourably decided in the Parliament of appointing a pension of 5.000 Pounds a year to Lord Birkenhead, which amounts to 50 thousand Roubles!

译自1929年1月9日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

阿富汗骚乱。

阿富汗报纸《Ania》（音译）写道：“过去几天，英国飞机飞越喀布尔市上空，投下各种传单。民众对英国的行为感到愤怒，英国人在过去十年里一直在阿富汗边境建立防御工事。我们知道，英国的每一个行动都是针对我们的”。该报还对英国人在呼吁中将暴乱者称为“宗教组织”表示愤慨。这样称呼暴乱者意味着使事态恶化。这也意味着英国人在侮辱、羞辱和干涉人民。如果英国的这种行为不停止，就有理由断言英国正寻求以武力干涉阿富汗事务。印度同情阿富汗。

大公之死。

关于上述事件，《红旗报》称“世界上少了一个白匪强盗”。

译自1929年1月10日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

英国对西藏的图谋。

上海8日电（塔斯社）：鉴于拟召开处理“中国边防”问题的会议，《申报》主张南京政府应特别关注西藏，英国正试图将其经济影响强加于西藏”。该报补充说，英国代表坚持要求西藏当局宣布西藏独立，并向他们承诺提供财政和军事援助。

哈尔滨的工会与解雇苏维埃雇员。

哈尔滨中文报纸《Gun Pao》（音译）发表两篇文章，抗议存在有苏维埃公民和雇员参加的工会。该报声称，由于这些工会的存在，北满工业遭受损失，因为对工业企业改善劳动条件的压力过大。
最近，许多苏维埃公民被各种企业、学校和组织解雇。

译自1929年1月11日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

数百万人挨饿，数百万人饱食。
来自伦敦的一封信。

伯肯黑德勋爵（Lord Birkenhead）是英国著名领袖和前上议院议长。他的名字今天出现在许多大型英国贸易和工业公司的招牌上。这位政治家和前上议院议长的广告效果极佳。这样的广告每月值得支付数千英镑。确实支付了这笔费用，勋爵也收到了钱。然而，他并不满足于此。这对他来说还“不够”。最近提出了一项议题，并在议会中获得有利通过，即给予伯肯黑德勋爵每年5,000英镑的养老金，折合5万卢布！

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Deputees receiving 4.000 Pounds for representing
"People's interests" voted for the pension. With the
united efforts of the Lords and leaders of Opposition
(against 33) the Parliament passed a bye law whereby
pensions amounting to I7 thousand a year and one time
rewards of 5I thousand in each case were to be paid to several
tens of "business people" who rendered valuable services to
the Cabinet of Chamberlain in the interests of the British
Empire.
At the same time:-
Famine has broken out in entire districts of coal
mining industry in the South Wales (Western England),
a famine of which even the bourgeois newspapers write
a great deal.
The total figure of unemployed in England has long ago
exceeded a million and a quarter. 4-5 million people including
families of labourers are in great poverty. Not all unemployed
by far receive the dole and even with that it is impossible
to maintain a family. The maximum pensions allowed to widows
and labourers having reached the age of 60 or 70 and more
are just about 2 to 3 thousand pounds.
The Pension law to the honourable Lords aroused the
protest in the Parliament even of the members of the Labour
Party, who are always ready"to serve". The regular members
of Parliament joined in the protest also, but McDonald
himself made them keep quiet. The labour press commented
on the pension granted to Lord Birkenhead and the discussion
of the case in Parliament was styled as "Trial". However
the interests of the Lord were defended in the name of the
Government by the Procurator General and the allies in the
Labour Party supported his case. Thus Lord Birkenhead was
granted a pension of a thousand a week not counting the
"gifts"of commercial concerns.
And there are millions of well-fed idlers alongside
millions of starving proletarians!

R. M.

Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya." of January I3, I929.

Seamen's Club in Leningrad.

Since I922 there is a "Foreign Seamen's Club" in
Leningrad, which is open to seamen of all nationalities
and where they can find every comfort during their sojourn
in town. In I928 during the navigation season the Club
was visited by 63.000 seamen, which speaks well for the
institution and requires no comment.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

那些因代表“人民利益”而收受4,000英镑的代表们投票支持了该养老金法案。在上议院议员和反对派领袖的共同努力下（反对票为33票），议会通过了一项附例，据此，向数十名曾为大英帝国利益向张伯伦内阁提供宝贵服务的“商界人士”支付每年17,000英镑的养老金，并在每种情况下给予一次性奖励51,000英镑。
与此同时：
英格兰南部威尔士（西英格兰）的整个煤矿工业区爆发了饥荒，连资产阶级报纸也对此进行了大量报道。
英国的失业总人数早已超过一百二十五万。包括劳工家属在内的四五百万人处于极度贫困之中。并非所有失业者都能领取救济金，即便领到，也无法维持家庭生计。允许发给寡妇以及年满60或70岁及以上劳工的最高养老金仅为约2,000至3,000英镑。
这项惠及尊贵上院议员的养老金法甚至在工党成员中引发了议会抗议，尽管这些成员总是准备“效劳”。正规议员也加入了抗议行列，但麦克唐纳本人让他们保持了沉默。劳工报刊对授予伯肯黑德勋爵（Lord Birkenhead）养老金一事进行了评论，并将议会对此案的讨论称为“审判”。然而，总检察长以政府的名义为这位勋爵的利益进行了辩护，工党内的盟友也支持他的立场。因此，伯肯黑德勋爵获得了每周1,000英镑的养老金，这还不包括商业机构给予的“礼物”。
一边是数百万饱食终日的闲人，另一边是数百万挨饿的无产者！

R. M.

译自1929年1月13日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

列宁格勒的海员俱乐部。

自1922年以来，列宁格勒设有一个“外国海员俱乐部”，向所有国籍的海员开放，他们在该市逗留期间可在此享受各种便利设施。1928年航行季节期间，该俱乐部接待了63,000名海员，这充分说明了该机构的成效，无需赘言。

Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) Dec. 30, I928.

Customs Tariff Autonomy for China.
and
Agreements have been reached between China England and
France on the Customs tariff autonomy. Nanking is thus on
the way of winning the Customs Autonomy with respect to every
Foreign Power. It has not been an easy task. Moreover the
agreements of England and France cannot be altogether regarded
as concessions to China. There must be a motive at the back
of it to smooth relations between the United States and Anglo-
French Alliance so that the Nanking Government does not get
much glory out of its victory. China has been of such vital
importance to foreign capitalism that there are bound to be
many more obstacles before the Autonomy is entirely established.
The concessions granted by England and France mean that these
countries will endeavour to secure the position of foreign
capital in China more than ever. It is another imperialistic
trick.

Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) Dec. 28, I928.

China and the Customs Tariff Autonomy.

A correspondent from Harbin named Mih. Valentinoff
writes on the subject of the Customs Tariff Autonomy about
to come into force on February I, I929. This will be a
historical date for China as the beginning of a new era
for China's industry. It will put China on a more equal
footing with other civilized countries and will improve
her financial state. Moreover Chinese peasants and labourers
will benefit as a result. Then there will also be new
agreements with the Foreign Powers. Japan has been protesting
against the new tariff as proposed by China as she will be
hard hit in some respects because of it. England will be the
next to feel it more keenly whilst America has to face but
slight increase.
The future prospects of Russo-Chinese trade are as
follows:- In I923 the transactions between these countries
amounted to 63 million Roubles. In I924 it reached the sum of
82 million extending to 90 millions in I925. In I926 it had
reached a maximum of I00 million Roubles, i.e. practically
the pre-war standing of I9I4.
Russia will be affected by the new tariff in an entirely
different way to that of other Powers:firstly because Russia
imports no luxuries or opium and secondly as she does not
entertain imperialistic tendencies to compete with Chinese
industry. Therefore U.S.S.R. cannot be displeased for any
reason with the introducing of national tariff in China
and is outside the interests in which imperialistic countries
and China are involved. The goods imported from Russia are
mostly timber, grain, fish, metal, etc. which are mostly needed
by China and on which the tax is quite small. On the other
hand China exports into Russia a large quantity of tea and
other Chinese products used in Soviet territory.
Soviet Russia is always glad to see China gaining her
freedom in whatever way it may as it leads the country out
of the plunderous reach of imperialists. Trade between U.S.S.R.
and China has every chance of developing in spite of the lately
existing political and diplomatic relations between China and
U.S.S.R. due to the narrow-sightedness of the Nanking Government.
page_data.zh:
译自1928年12月30日的《红旗报》（Red Banner）。

中国的关税自主权。
以及
中英法三国已就关税自主权达成协议。南京政府正走在赢得对所有列强关税自主权的道路上。这并非易事。此外，英法的协议不能完全被视为对中国的让步。其背后必有动机，即缓和美国与英法联盟之间的关系，使得南京政府无法从其胜利中获得太多荣耀。中国对外国资本主义至关重要，因此在完全确立自主权之前，必然会有更多障碍。英法给予的让步意味着这些国家将比以往更加努力地确保外国资本在中国的地位。这是另一种帝国主义伎俩。

译自1928年12月28日的《红旗报》（Red Banner）。

中国与关税自主权。

一位来自哈尔滨、名为米哈伊尔·瓦伦丁诺夫（Mih. Valentinoff）的记者就即将于1929年2月1日生效的关税自主权问题撰文。这对中国来说将是一个具有历史意义的日期，标志着中国工业新时代的开始。这将使中国与其他文明国家处于更平等的地位，并改善其财政状况。此外，中国农民和劳工也将因此受益。随后还将与列强达成新协议。日本一直对中国提出的新关税表示抗议，因为她在某些方面将受到沉重打击。英国将是下一个感受到更强烈影响的国家，而美国面临的增幅则微乎其微。
俄中贸易的未来前景如下：1923年，两国之间的交易额达到6,300万卢布。1924年达到8,200万，1925年增至9,000万。1926年达到最高值1亿卢布，即实际上达到了1914年战前的水平。
俄罗斯受新关税的影响方式与其他列强完全不同：首先，因为俄罗斯不进口奢侈品或鸦片；其次，因为她没有与中国工业竞争的帝国主义倾向。因此，苏联不会因任何原因对中国实施民族关税感到不满，且置身于帝国主义国家与中国所卷入的利益之外。从俄罗斯进口的货物主要是木材、粮食、鱼类、金属等，这些大多是中国所需的，且税额很低。另一方面，中国向俄罗斯出口大量茶叶及其他在苏联境内使用的中国产品。
苏维埃俄罗斯总是乐于见到中国以任何方式获得自由，因为这使国家摆脱了帝国主义的掠夺范围。尽管由于南京政府的短视，中俄之间最近存在政治和外交关系问题，但苏中贸易仍有发展的充分机会。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of October 28 and 27, 1928.

Canton the hearth of revolution.
( Own Correspondent from Shanghai. )

Kwangtung Province is the hearth of revolution in China.
The Communist Party and the Union of Communistic Youth of China
should remember Kwangtung in particular as the scene of serious
fighting for the ideals of revolution and communism and the
establishment of the first peasants and labourers Government
after people of the above two categories laid down their lives
for the Soviet Government. Even now Kwangtung is very active
and searches, arrests and executions of the people are still
continuing there to-day. Literature of revolutionary tendency
is seized when discovered in book-stores and on the streets.
arrests of communists also take place in Swatow and Amoy.
The situation in Kwangtung and the information we are able
to collect shows that although the peasants in villages and
labourers in cities are willing to struggle for their freedom
in spite of the repressions used against them by the authorities
of the Kwangtung Province. If not able to help in action the
peasants and labourers shelter their comrades, give them food
and assist them in various other ways. Revolution is a
living thing in Kwangtung and the true spirit of it in China
is there.
V. L.

Shanghai, October 15, 1928.

Travels of Martzinuk.

Vladivostock merchant Martzinuk is a man of the category
of people who are considered by some as frauds and by other
"business men".
The Fishing Trust of the State in the Far East paid out
to Martzinuk 2000 roubles as an advance sum for the hire
of a motor launch, owned by the latter and Martzinuk left
Vladivostock and proceeded to Japan on the same motor launch
taking away the 2000 roubles with him also. Upon investigation
made it was ascertained that for some time already Martzinuk
has been carrying on business with a large Japanese firm known
by the name of Suzuki and has been concealing his profits
from the authorities. How is that the authorities do not
keep a better watch on the activities of persons similar to
Martzinuk. He has managed to escape to Japan, but what about
the many more of his kind continuing to do successful business
for their own advantage still to be found in Vladivostock?

译自1928年10月28日和27日的《红旗报》。

广州：革命的摇篮。
（上海特派记者。）

广东省是中国的革命摇篮。中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团应特别铭记广东，这里是人们为革命和共产主义理想、为建立第一个工农政府而进行激烈斗争的场所，上述两类人为苏维埃政府献出了生命。即便现在，广东依然非常活跃，搜查、逮捕和处决民众的行为至今仍在继续。具有革命倾向的出版物一旦在书店和街头被发现即被没收。在汕头和厦门也发生了逮捕共产党员的事件。
广东的局势以及我们收集到的信息显示，尽管广东省当局对农民和城市劳工进行镇压，但他们仍愿意为自由而斗争。如果无法在行动中提供帮助，农民和劳工会庇护他们的同志，提供食物并以各种其他方式协助他们。革命在广东是鲜活的存在，中国真正的革命精神亦在于此。
V. L.

上海，1928年10月15日。

马尔齐努克（Martzinuk）的行踪。

符拉迪沃斯托克商人马尔齐努克属于这样一类人：有些人视其为骗子，另一些人则称其为“生意人”。
远东国家渔业信托基金向马尔齐努克支付了2,000卢布，作为租用后者拥有的摩托艇的预付款，马尔齐努克随即乘坐该摩托艇离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往日本，同时也带走了这2,000卢布。经调查查明，马尔齐努克已在一段时间内与一家名为铃木（Suzuki）的大型日本公司开展业务，并向当局隐瞒其利润。当局为何不对类似马尔齐努克这类人的活动进行更严密的监视？他已成功逃往日本，但在符拉迪沃斯托克仍有许多像他这样的人继续为了自身利益成功经商，这些人又当如何处置？

page_data.en:
Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of Nov. 2, 1923,
Politicians-Business men. (Own Correspondent from Shanghai)

Under the existing customs in Shanghai opposition to
communism and communists appears to be an occupation of honour
and advantage. Consequently in addition to members of the
Foreign and Chinese Police, Military Authorities and everyone
official, those who wish to gain something by this profession
engage in it.
In this article we wish to show how people enrich themselves
under the slogan of "Fight the worst enemy of the world - communism".
Some time ago in a Chinese shop of some kind a tablet with the
following inscription was found:- "Jesus Christ told his two
imperialistic disciples TANAKA and MUSSOLINI that human beings
were all equal, hence all unequal treaties should be abolished
or else they would not get into the Kingdom of God".
It goes without saying that the above "propaganda" tablet
is very foolish. Nevertheless the Chairman of the local
"Anti-Communist" Society, Captain Howard, took serious note of
the tablet in question and addressed a strong letter of indignation
in some newspaper against the owners of the shop for the insult
of the christian feelings of its customers, for introducing
politics into religion, etc.etc. advocating that the British
and other foreigners should boycott the shop.
Supporters of the society made donations to promote further
anti-communist activities. This, however, is not the main income.
In 1925 the "Constitutional Defence League" was organized locally
to oppose communism and the growing Labour movement in Shanghai
and China generally. The League obtained large funds to function
and for a couple of months published bulletins which were
distributed free. Towards the end of the third year of its
existence the League supporters got tired of assisting the
Society as in spite of its propaganda the labour movement and
communism showed a tendency to increase in lieu of subsiding.
Merchants and Factory owners discontinued donations and the
League ceased to exist. Following this trouble arose amongst
former members of the League who went on accusing one another
of inactivity, the wasting of funds for nothing, speculations,
etc. The wealthy supporters asked for an account of expenditure.
The League was long in deciding to give an account but finally
submitted it and it was published for the benefit of those
concerned. The striking feature of the accounts was that
the largest sums were credited to items under "various", "secret"
and such like headings. A remark was made that the League
could not reveal to the public what actually the "secret"
expenses were. Everybody in town, however, knew that the money
collected was used to pay big salaries, banquets and women.
Things like this should not be mentioned aloud as they might
compromise the "ideal" fighters of communism.
Last year when foreign troops in Shanghai were so numerous
the publication of a journal entitled "Safety First" was started
for propaganda amongst the army men. In this case too the
usual steps were taken to establish business. After 26 issues
the publication ceased to exist and shortly afterwards rumours
were circulated that inaccuracies in dealing with funds of
the journal were discovered. The patriotic British firm
to whom the publication was entrusted was forced to give an
account after a lot of discussion and although at first accounts
were found correct, revelations soon followed. The newspaper
it proved had two editors. One of these edited the first five
issues and was then for some reason dismissed whilst the next
21 issues were edited by some other people. It was the first
editor that gave the show away. He said how could they have
spent almost one and a half thousand dollars to publish every
issue when I managed to do it with three or four hundred dollars
only.
page_data.zh:
译自1923年11月2日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya），
政客与商人。（本报驻上海通讯员）

在上海现行的习俗下，反对共产主义和共产党人似乎成了一项既光荣又有利的职业。因此，除了外国和华人警察、军事当局以及所有官方人员外，那些希望借此谋利的人也投身于此业。
在本文中，我们要展示人们如何在“打击世界最凶恶的敌人——共产主义”的口号下发家致富。
不久前，在某家中国商店里发现了一块牌匾，上面刻着如下文字：“耶稣基督告诉他的两位帝国主义弟子田中（TANAKA）和墨索里尼（MUSSOLINI），人生而平等，因此所有不平等条约都应废除，否则他们便无法进入天国。”
不言而喻，上述这块“宣传”牌匾十分愚蠢。然而，当地“反共”协会主席霍华德（Howard）上尉却对这块牌匾予以严重关注，并在某家报纸上发表了一封措辞强烈的抗议信，指责店主侮辱了顾客的基督教情感，将政治引入宗教等等，并主张英国人及其他外国人应抵制该店。
协会的支持者捐款以推动进一步的反共活动。然而，这并非主要收入来源。
1925年，本地组织了“宪政保卫联盟”，以反对共产主义以及上海乃至全中国日益壮大的劳工运动。该联盟获得了大量运作资金，并在几个月内出版了免费分发的简报。在其成立后的第三年年底，联盟的支持者因厌倦了资助该协会而感到疲惫，因为尽管进行了宣传，劳工运动和共产主义不仅没有平息，反而呈现出增长的趋势。商人和工厂主停止了捐款，联盟随之解散。此后，联盟前成员之间发生了纠纷，互相指责对方不作为、浪费资金、投机倒把等。富有的支持者要求公布支出账目。联盟迟迟不愿公布账目，但最终还是提交了，并为相关人士予以刊登。账目中引人注目的特点是，最大笔的金额被列为“杂项”、“秘密”等名目。有人指出，联盟不能向公众透露“秘密”开支的具体内容。然而，城里人人都知道，筹集的资金被用于支付高薪、举办宴会和供养女性。此类事情不应大声宣扬，以免损害那些“理想主义”的反共斗士的名誉。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The patriots who dismissed me acquired motor cars,
secretaries, stenographers and paid large salaries to all
these people not forgetting themselves. The printing office
of the British patriotic firm got enriched on the transaction
together with the editors, collaborators and others whilst
the soldiers gained nothing by it, except a few issues of
a useless paper and a dinner one night on which a hundred
dollars were spent by the promoters.
    One would imagine that the man who disclosed these
matters would express indignation at the same time. Nothing
of the sort. In Shanghai one is accustomed to such things.
Everyone here knows that opposition to communism, enlightening
of the soldiers minds and other similar works of charity
should be well rewarded. The first editor said in future
he would be wiser himself and not forget his own interests
in such work.                ways of
    In spite of the all round misleading and obtaining means
under false pretexts, with a view to fighting communism, and
the fact that tens of persons engaged professionally in this
work live in full comforts and luxury as a result of gaining
wealth by the above means, local well-to-do class is for ever
prepared to supply them with donations for the support of
various funds of anti-communist societies. The "professionals"
in their turn always continue to frighten the bourgeoisie
with wild rumours of conspiracies, communist uprisings,
forthcoming massacres and similar happenings, these rumours
being mostly based and enlarged on some small event such as
the discovery of a pamphlet a speech delivered somewhere, etc.,and
great importance being attached to these things of insignificance.
    Stories are made up that red partisans have massacred
a lot of women and children, that houses have been pillaged
and children left homeless and destitute, etc. followed by
questions:- "Will you ever permit that your houses, children
and wives should be treated by the Reds in this manner? You
must oppose this by all means available and the best way to that
is to donate towards our fund. Be careful as the Reds and
Communists are very cunning and clever. They penetrate
everywhere. Imagine it, they have been discovered even in
the ████ Young Men's Christian Association and have made a
dangerous nest of it! Insure yourselves. Subscribe to our Fund!"
    People are found in numbers willing to insure themselves
and pay money into the funds of the Societies, Part of it will
be used to cover the expenses of luxury and pleasures of the

去年，当驻沪外国军队数量众多时，一份名为《安全第一》（Safety First）的期刊开始出版，旨在对军人进行宣传。在这种情况下，也采取了通常的商业手段来建立业务。在出版了26期后，该刊物停办，不久后便有谣言流传，称发现该刊在处理资金方面存在不实之处。受托出版该刊的那家爱国的英国公司在经过大量讨论后被迫公布账目，虽然起初账目看似正确，但随后很快出现了揭露真相的情况。事实证明，该报有两名编辑。其中一人编辑了前五期，后因某种原因被解雇，而接下来的21期则由其他人编辑。正是第一位编辑揭穿了这场骗局。他说，我仅用三四百美元就能出版每一期，他们怎么可能花费近一千五百美元来出版每一期呢？

解雇我的那些爱国者购置了汽车，雇佣了秘书、速记员，并向所有这些人大发高薪，当然也没有忘记他们自己。那家爱国的英国公司的印刷所连同编辑、撰稿人及其他人员都从中发了财，而士兵们除了得到几份无用的报纸和 promoters（发起人）花费一百美元举办的一次晚宴外，一无所获。
人们或许会认为，揭露这些事的人同时会表达愤慨。事实并非如此。在上海，人们对这类事情已习以为常。这里的人都知道，反对共产主义、启迪士兵思想以及其他类似的慈善工作应当得到丰厚的回报。第一位编辑表示，今后他会更加精明，在此类工作中不会忘记自己的利益。

尽管存在全方位的误导和以虚假借口获取手段以打击共产主义，且事实上数十名专业从事此项工作的人通过上述手段致富，过着舒适奢华的生活，但本地的富裕阶层仍随时准备向他们提供捐款，以支持各种反共协会的资金。“专业人士”则反过来继续用关于阴谋、共产党起义、即将发生的大屠杀及类似事件的荒诞谣言来恐吓资产阶级，这些谣言大多基于并夸大了一些小事件，如发现一份小册子、某处发表的演讲等，并将这些微不足道的事情赋予极大的重要性。
人们编造故事说，红色游击队屠杀了许多妇女和儿童，房屋遭到洗劫，儿童流离失所、陷入贫困等等，随后提出质问：“你们难道允许你们的房屋、子女和妻子受到赤色分子如此对待吗？你们必须利用一切可用手段加以反对，而最好的办法就是向我们的基金捐款。要小心，因为赤色分子和共产党人非常狡猾聪明。他们无孔不入。试想一下，他们甚至在████基督教青年会中被发现，并将其变成了一个危险的巢穴！请为自己投保。认购我们的基金！”
许多人愿意为自己投保并向协会基金付款。其中一部分将被用于覆盖发起人的奢侈享乐开支，其余部分则用于出版无用且徒劳的文献。
                                V. R. (Rover?)

Translation from the "Izvestia" (Moscow) of November 10 and 1, 19:

An appeal to all labour organizations and workers.

On the occasion of the IIth anniversary of Soviet Union of Socialistic Republics, the Committee of All Russian Central Labour Unions Organization issued an appeal to the world labour organizations and workers reminding them of the victory of the proletarians all over the world and the success of labour movement in every country in conjunction with the principles of Marx and Lenin. It advocated that U.S.S.R. was the common native land for all proletarians and that it would be proclaimed as such during the celebrations of the anniversary. Socialistic experiments in Soviet Russia during the past eleven years have proved the solidarity of the international proletariat and the victory of labour over capital. Labour unions should continue to co-operate and promote socialism in the people's masses of all countries. Long live the international proletarian revolution. Advance in the spreading of socialistic teaching. May the proletarians united around the All-Russian Communist Party (Bolsheviks) and with them labour unions to promote socialism.
May the country be industrialized and agriculture follow socialistic principles.
Long live the 7 hour labour day.
Long live the Labour Class of U.S.S.R.
Long live the glorious anniversary of proletarian victory over the bourgeoisie.
Proletarians of all countries unite.

Construction of the Turkestan-Siberian Railway.

At a Government meeting in Kremlin the question was brought up for discussion for the completion of construction of the Turkestan-Siberian Railway at which it was said that possibly the completion could be effected before the end of 1930, work on the construction to be increased during 1929.

Translation from the "Izvestia" of October 30 and 28, 1928.

Trade between U.S.S.R. and Afghanistan.

The Afghan section attached to the Allied-Eastern Chamber of Commerce in Moscow made the following report on the possibilities of trade between Afghanistan and U.S.S.R. Under favourable conditions it is possible to export from Afghanistan large quantities of raw material for Soviet Russia as well as wool and cotton. The export of the latter goods is not considerable at present but was so prior to the Great War. It is also expected that goods manufactured in Soviet Russia could be exported to Afghanistan. During the past year satisfactory results of commercial exchange in goods were obtained between the North of Afghanistan and Russia. Endeavours are now being made to extend trade to the South of Afghanistan.

International Union of Communistic Youth.

The activities of the Soviet Union of Communistic Youth have been very useful for organizations in China, which grew from small student groups into organized proletariat of youth embracing large numbers. The example of China proves how much can be accomplished by the communistic youth in colonial countries. One can be proud of the Chinese Section which is steady in spite of the strong bourgeois opposition. It was the success of the Union in China that led to the decision of organizing similar unions in all colonial countries when the Vth Congress of the Communistic Youth was held.

译自1928年11月10日和11日莫斯科《消息报》（Izvestia）：

致所有劳工组织和工人的呼吁书。

值此苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟成立十一周年之际，全俄中央工会组织委员会向世界劳工组织和工人发出呼吁，提醒他们牢记全世界无产者的胜利，以及各国劳工运动结合马克思和列宁原则所取得的成功。它主张苏联是所有无产者的共同祖国，并将在周年庆祝活动中予以宣告。过去十一年间苏维埃俄罗斯的社会主义实验证明了国际无产阶级的团结以及劳动对资本的胜利。工会应继续合作，促进各国人民大众中的社会主义。国际无产阶级革命万岁。推进社会主义教义的传播。愿无产者团结在全俄共产党（布尔什维克）周围，并与工会一道促进社会主义。
愿国家实现工业化，农业遵循社会主义原则。
七小时工作日万岁。
苏联工人阶级万岁。
无产阶级战胜资产阶级的光荣周年万岁。
全世界无产者，联合起来。

突厥斯坦-西伯利亚铁路的建设。

在克里姆林宫举行的政府会议上，提出了完成突厥斯坦-西伯利亚铁路建设的问题进行讨论，会上表示，工程有可能在1930年底前完工，1929年将加大建设力度。

译自1928年10月28日和30日《消息报》：

苏联与阿富汗之间的贸易。

附属于莫斯科 Allied-Eastern Chamber of Commerce（盟国东方商会）的阿富汗分部就阿富汗与苏联之间的贸易可能性提交了以下报告。在有利的条件下，可以从阿富汗向苏维埃俄罗斯出口大量原材料，以及羊毛和棉花。后者的出口目前规模不大，但在大战之前曾相当可观。预计苏维埃俄罗斯制造的商品也可以出口到阿富汗。在过去一年中，阿富汗北部与俄罗斯之间的商品商业交换取得了令人满意的结果。目前正努力将贸易扩展至阿富汗南部。

共产主义青年国际联盟。

苏联共产主义青年联盟的活动对中国各组织非常有益，这些组织从小型学生团体发展成为囊括大量青年的有组织无产阶级青年队伍。中国的例子证明了共产主义青年在殖民地国家能够取得多大的成就。人们可以为中国分部感到自豪，尽管面临强烈的资产阶级反对，它依然稳固。正是该联盟在中国的成功，促使在举行共产主义青年第五次代表大会时，决定在所有殖民地国家组织类似的联盟。

country at present there are only individual communistic
groups of youth. An extensive wave of strikes in the country
shows the ways and means towards success of the communistic

Translation from the "Izvestia" of October 26 and 18, 1928.

Return of released prisoners of Soviet Embassy in Peking.
out
On October 25 a second group of 15 men formerly attached to
the Soviet Embassy in Peking returned to Moscow after an
imprisonment of 17 months as a result of the raid on Soviet
Embassy in Peking in 1927.
The names of the arrivals were:- Grigorieff, Konstantinoff,
Malisheff, Tolkacheff, Toukh, Himchinsky and Vasin. Another
member of the group named Verhotin remained for a few days in
Chita and will reach Moscow later.

A photograph of the ex prisoners of Soviet Embassy in Peking
numbering 15 is reproduced in the "Izvestia" of October 18,
accompanied by an article describing their sad plight and
hardships of imprisonment during 17 months, without any real
trial until a change of Government in September 1928 when they
were released. Even then reactionary and anti-Soviet elements
opposed, undoubtedly upon instigation of the British, their
release and insisted on a sentence being passed to show the
guilt of the prisoners.

Translation from the "Izvestia" of October 23, 1928.

Outrageous treatment of a Soviet Scientist by British
Authorities in Egypt.

Markovitch, Professor of Botany, whilst returning from an
expedition to India via Egypt encountered difficulties with
the British Consular Authorities over his visa, sojourn in
British territory, etc. On arriving in Leningrad he related
the incident to his Scientific Colleagues who expressed their
great indignation at the outrageous treatment of Markovitch by
the British Authorities. They, however, emphasized the
friendly attitude with which Professor Markovitch was met
by the Indian scientists whilst the British proved themselves
extremely tactless and impolite to a representative of science
of U.S.S.R.
A resolution passed by the scientists of Leningrad was to
the following effect:- "In their blinded enmity against the
U.S.S.R. members of the British Government forget the most
elementary international tactics. A scientist, not guilty of
any crime or offence, was practically under arrest for 5½ months.
The Leningrad Section of Scientists hopes that this outrageous
act against their colleague will be protested against by the
scientists of all other countries. They extend sincere thanks
to the Indian scientists for their kind attitude. The treatment
received by Professor Markovitch at the hands of the Egyptian
Authorities is not the first of its kind. All Soviet scientists
are subject to such mocking and treatment whilst proceeding
through British territory. In no other country in the world are
scientists of U.S.S.R. treated in this manner. Soviet Russia
treats scientists from other countries with great attention.
No scientists from Russia is ever entrusted with propaganda or
political mission. British Authorities in Egypt and other colo-
nies always see "red" danger in every Soviet scientist. It is
hoped that in future there will be no repetition of such treatment.

印度有许多工作要做，该国目前只有零星的青年共产主义团体。该国大规模的罢工浪潮显示了在这个大英帝国主义殖民地中，青年共产主义者取得成功的方法和途径。至于其他殖民国家，那里也已组织了小型的青年共产主义团体。国际共产主义青年团的任务是在苏联共产主义青年团的援助下，增加这些国家青年的数量和活动。

译自1928年10月26日和18日的《消息报》。

北京苏联大使馆获释囚犯返回。
10月25日，前隶属于北京苏联大使馆的第二批15名男子在经历了17个月的监禁后返回莫斯科，这是1927年突袭北京苏联大使馆的结果。
抵达者的姓名为：格里戈里耶夫（Grigorieff）、康斯坦丁诺夫（Konstantinoff）、马利舍夫（Malisheff）、托尔卡切夫（Tolkacheff）、图赫（Toukh）、希姆钦斯基（Himchinsky）和瓦辛（Vasin）。该团体的另一名成员维尔霍廷（Verhotin）在赤塔停留了几天，稍后将抵达莫斯科。

10月18日的《消息报》刊登了一张北京苏联大使馆前囚犯共15人的照片，并附有一篇文章，描述了他们在17个月监禁期间的悲惨处境和艰辛，直到1928年9月政府更迭他们获释之前，一直没有经过真正的审判。即便在那时，反动和反苏元素无疑是在英国的煽动下，反对释放他们，并坚持要判处刑罚以显示囚犯的罪行。

译自1928年10月23日的《消息报》。

英国当局在埃及对一位苏联科学家的粗暴对待。

植物学教授马尔科维奇（Markovitch）在经由埃及从印度考察归来时，因签证、在英国领土逗留等问题与英国领事当局发生争执。抵达列宁格勒后，他向科学同事们讲述了这一事件，同事们对英国当局对马尔科维奇的粗暴对待表示极大愤慨。然而，他们强调指出，印度科学家对马尔科维奇教授持友好态度，而英国人则证明自己对一位苏联科学代表极其缺乏策略且无礼。
列宁格勒科学家通过的一项决议内容如下：“英国政府成员在对苏联的盲目敌对中，忘记了最基本的国际准则。一名未犯任何罪行的科学家实际上被逮捕了5个半月。列宁格勒科学家分会希望，其他各国的科学家能对这种针对其同事的粗暴行为提出抗议。他们对印度科学家的善意态度表示诚挚感谢。马尔科维奇教授在埃及当局手中受到的待遇并非首例。所有苏联科学家在经过英国领土时都会遭受此类嘲弄和待遇。世界上没有任何其他国家以这种方式对待苏联科学家。苏维埃俄罗斯非常关注来自其他国家的科学家。从未有俄罗斯科学家被委派进行宣传或政治任务。埃及及其他殖民地的英国当局总是在每一位苏联科学家身上看到‘红色’危险。希望将来不再重演此类待遇。”

Moscow, November 22, 1925.

The National City Bank, which is heading a group of Russian pre-war bond holders, refused to join the International Committee of the Russian bond holders. The negative attitude of the American business men, who certainly do not deserve a reproach for neglecting their interests, demonstrates the obvious fact that the London International Committee is in reality not an economic but rather a political organisation aiming not at the conclusion of a reasonable financial agreement but on the contrary wishes to prevent such an agreement from being reached for the sake of the general aims of the aggressive anti-soviet policy. The American business men by their refusal to have anything in common with the International Committee of Russian creditors have again shown their sound realism which has already been referred to by us in connection with a well known agreement of the General Electric Co which permits an optimistic appreciation of the prospects of the development of Soviet-American economic relations and of the settlement, on mutually profitable conditions, of all outstanding problems. It is to be regretted that Banking circles in Germany - the country which, owing to the existing treaty relations, is intimately tied up with USSR and from whose business circles one could expect not only a correct estimation of their interests with regard to USSR but also a right interpretation of the existing treaty obligations with regard to that country - have shown themselves not sufficiently realistic and, unlike the USSR, have permitted themselves to be engaged in irresponsible and fruitless political intrigue.

The position assumed by the National City Bank presents a serious blow to the London organisation of the international bond holders, who are cherishing very high hopes upon this cooperation. This position gives another proof of a difference existing between the methods employed by America in its relations with the Soviet Union and those of Britain, which as is well known, is inspiring the policy of the international committee and which is pursuing by this policy not only the general aim of mobilisation of anti-soviet forces throughout the world, but is striving at the same time to prevent other countries from safeguarding their interests by direct agreement with the Soviet Union.-

花旗银行（National City Bank）作为一个俄国战前债券持有人群体的牵头方，拒绝加入俄国债券持有人国际委员会。美国商界人士的否定态度——他们当然不应因忽视自身利益而受到指责——表明了一个显而易见的事实：伦敦国际委员会实际上不是一个经济组织，而是一个政治组织，其目的不是达成合理的金融协议，相反，为了侵略性反苏政策的总体目标，它希望阻止达成此类协议。美国商界人士通过拒绝与俄国债权人国际委员会有任何瓜葛，再次展示了他们健全的务实精神，我们此前在提及通用电气公司（General Electric Co.）的一项著名协议时曾提到过这一点，该协议使人们对苏美经济关系的发展前景以及在此基础上互利解决所有悬而未决的问题持乐观评价。令人遗憾的是，德国银行业圈子——该国由于现有的条约关系与苏联紧密相连，人们本期望其商界不仅能正确评估其对苏联的利益，还能正确解释对该国现有的条约义务——表现得不够务实，并且不像苏联那样，让自己卷入不负责任且毫无成果的政治阴谋中。

花旗银行所持立场对国际债券持有人的伦敦组织造成了沉重打击，后者对这种合作寄予厚望。这一立场再次证明了美国在与苏联关系中所采用的方法与英国的方法存在差异，众所周知，英国正在主导国际委员会的政策，并通过该政策不仅旨在动员全球范围内的反苏力量，同时还努力阻止其他国家通过与苏联直接协议来保障其利益。-

A descendant of Genghis Khan. Such is the name of a new Soviet cinema production. This film, in which the author has used ethnographic material, is not an ethnographic film at all. It represents Mongolia at the time of the struggle of the reds and whites in Siberia and British occupation of the Mongolian stepes. The author very cleverly and clearly shows how British capital and its defenders are exploiting and oppressing the hunter and the nomad tribes.

The British military barracks are shown to perfection without any special Russian blunders. There is a thrilling scene of military execution. Though it is not emphasized by any kind of hints those who see the film will become fully aware that British Tommy Atkins has no wish whatever to kill the Mongol for the sake of capital. This is one of many cases wherein the author does not expound on the theme, but only gives a hint by some casual stroke, yet the idea will form itself in the minds of those who see the film.

New air line.

The following new ail line has been projected:Tihoretskaia -Sochi (293 kilometr.)_Soohum (126 kil.)-Kutais (160 kil.)-Tiflis (180 kil.), Gandja-Baku (525 kil.) The total length is 1279 k.

There are on this line fine possibilities for perfectly equipped aerodroms, assuring normal working of the line during the year. The line will be served by aeroplanes of the Kalinin type K-4, having a good speed and all technical appliances necessary for this kind of work. Preparations will be completed within the next two months so that the line may be expected to be opened early in January 1929.

成吉思汗的后裔。这是一部新的苏联电影作品的片名。这部影片虽然作者使用了民族志材料，但绝非一部民族志电影。它展现了西伯利亚红军与白军斗争以及英国占领蒙古草原时期的蒙古景象。作者非常巧妙且清晰地展示了英国资本及其捍卫者如何剥削和压迫猎人和游牧部落。

影片完美地呈现了英国军营，没有任何特别的俄罗斯式失误。其中有一个令人紧张的军事处决场景。虽然没有任何暗示加以强调，但观看影片的人会充分意识到，英国士兵汤米·阿特金斯（Tommy Atkins）根本不愿意为了资本去杀害蒙古人。这是作者不阐述主题，仅通过随意的笔触给出暗示，从而让观看者在脑海中形成想法的众多案例之一。

Translation from the "Izvestia" of December 13, 1928.

Sentence in the case of counterfeit Chervontzi in
Shanghai. Strange leniency of the French Court.

Shanghai, November (by post). At the end of October the
Mixed Court of the French Concession in Shanghai passed a
sentence in the case of three Russian whites, who were charged
with counterfeiting Soviet Chervontzi. News to the effect
that an organization existed in Shanghai engaged in counter-
feiting Chervontzi was received in the early Spring of 1928,
but it could be expected that the whites, employed in the
French Police, at the first attempt of starting a case would
in time inform the offenders and these latter would succeed
in transferring their concern to another place. In September,
however, three of the accused were arrested and the printing
press, types, numbering machines and counterfeited Chervontzi
to the amount of 1.500 thousand dollars, were seized.
The French Mixed court declined the application against
the accused of Para 230 of the Chinese Criminal Code (falsifica-
tion of lawful coins of a foreign government) and applied
article 242 of the same code (falsification of money documents).
On the strength of this article two of the accused were
sentenced to imprisonment for two months and the third to
one month's imprisonment, also the sentence in respect of one
of the accused being conditional. The time served under
remand was included for all the accused in the final sentence.
"White" newspapers were remarking at the time that the
offenders were very pleased with the sentence and greeted
the last part of it with a smile.

Not so very long ago France herself was faced with the
existence of an organization abroad counterfeiting French
bank notes. We remember how excited everybody in France
was upon the discovery of the organization and with what
energy the French Government insisted on the severe punishment
being meted by the Hungarian Court against the accused. It
would seem that having encountered an attempt at counterfeiting
the official coins of U.S.S.R., [illegible] a country with which
France is maintaining normal diplomatic relations - the French
Court in Shanghai would treat the matter with equal severity.
Instead of that the Court passed a laughable sentence, which
was equal to dismissing the case. Evidently when the matter
concerns Soviet Russia, obligations recognized generally and
practice of international and criminal laws to be observed,
cease to exist for the French Court.
The passing of a sentence of that nature when the guilt
of the accused was beyond dispute cannot but cause [illegible]
surprise and protest on the part of the Soviet people. By this
sentence and reasons for it (reference to political purpose
governing the counterfeiting of Chervontzi as a redeeming
feature in the circumstances), the French Court in Shanghai
has proved that on becoming the weapon of political prejudices
and blind hatred towards the Soviet regime, it disregards
even its own dignity and the elementary foundations of
bourgeois recognition of right.

上海伪造切尔文涅茨券案判决。法国法庭奇怪的宽纵。

上海，11月（邮递）。10月底，上海法租界会审公廪对三名被控伪造苏联切尔文涅茨券（Chervontzi）的白俄作出了判决。关于上海存在一个从事伪造切尔文涅茨券的组织的消息是在1928年初春收到的，但可以预料，受雇于法国警察局的白俄会在案件启动的第一时间通知罪犯，而这些罪犯则会成功将其业务转移到其他地方。然而，9月份，三名被告被捕，印刷机、字模、打号机以及价值150万美元的伪造切尔文涅茨券被查获。
法国会审公廪驳回了对被告适用《中国刑法典》第230条（伪造外国政府法定货币）的申请，并适用了该法典第242条（伪造货币票据）。依据该条款，两名被告被判处两个月监禁，第三名被告被判处一个月监禁，其中一名被告的判决为缓刑。所有被告在还押期间服刑的时间均计入最终刑期。
当时的“白俄”报纸评论称，罪犯对判决非常满意，并对判决的最后部分报以微笑。

不久前，法国自己也面临着海外存在伪造法国纸币的组织的问题。我们记得，当发现该组织时，法国上下多么激动，法国政府又是多么有力地坚持要求匈牙利法院对被告施以严厉惩罚。似乎既然遇到了伪造与其保持正常外交关系的国家——苏联——的法定货币的企图，上海的法国法庭会以同样的严厉态度处理此事。然而，法庭却作出了一项可笑的判决，这等同于撤销案件。显然，当涉及苏维埃俄罗斯时，普遍承认的义务以及应遵守的国际法和刑法惯例，对法国法庭而言便不复存在。
在被告罪行无可争议的情况下作出此种性质的判决，难免引起苏联人民的（原文不清）惊讶和抗议。通过这一判决及其理由（引用伪造切尔文涅茨券的政治目的作为情况中的减刑情节），上海法国法庭证明，一旦成为政治偏见和对苏维埃政权盲目仇恨的工具，它甚至不顾及自身的尊严和资产阶级权利观念的基本基础。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) Dec. 11, 1923.
Vladivostock.

Long live Chinese Revolution.

To-day is the anniversary of the heroic uprising of
proletarians in Canton. This event will never be forgotten
by either the Chinese peasants and labourers or the proletariat
of the world. The Canton uprising was suppressed after three
days' duration. It could not resist the imperialist forces.
The revolution is however still living. Soviet influence
is spreading and more people are joining revolutionary ranks
in the different provinces of China. Chinese revolution is
guided by the communists and its triumph is not far. Long
live the Revolution of China!

Three photographs in connection with the uprising in
Canton are reproduced with the following inscriptions:-
Defence of the Canton Commune - "revolutionary demonstrations
in the Red Canton. In those days labour detachments of defence
were formed in the streets".
Landing of British troops in Hongkong - "Here British
imperialists centred forces to suppress revolutionary movement
in China".
Execution of participants in the Canton uprising - " 'Civilised
gentlemen' assist at the execution".
Chiang-Kai-Shek - "Executioner of Chinese Revolution".

Communist parties of the whole world including that of
Russia should now make serious preparations for the forth-
coming revolutionary wave in China. "Defence of Chinese
Revolution" should become the constant motto of the
propaganda and agitation of the Communist Parties.

Meetings on the occasion of the Canton
uprising anniversary.

Chinese Section attached to the District Committee of
the Party will hold a meeting at the 1st of May Chinese Club
on the occasion of the Canton uprising anniversary, at 6 p.m.
Chinese cargo coolies will hold a short meeting at
tiffin interval on the Canton uprising.
The Chinese newspaper "Labourers' Way" contained several
historical articles and information connected with the
revolutionary happenings in Canton.

Vladivostock Council elections.

Chinese labourers elected a new deputy for the Council
named Comrade Liu Chin-Mei and Comrade Liu Ziang-Chi is
his candidate.

In a review of the situation in Chinese Provinces
by a correspondent from Shanghai, the writer reports that
in the North of China new school books have been distributed
amongst pupils in different schools. In one of these there
is the following question and answer:- "Why does foreign
trade in China flourish to such an extent"? - "Because China
has lost rights to tax foreign goods".

Chinese Press in Vladivostock advocates the necessity
of a Chinese cinema for the laboures being opened in lieu
of two dramatic plays theatres already in existence.
(Dec. 12, 1923).

译自1923年12月11日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。
符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。

中国革命万岁。

今天是广州无产阶级英雄起义的周年纪念日。这一事件将永远不会被中国农民和工人以及世界无产阶级所遗忘。广州起义在持续三天后被镇压。它无法抵抗帝国主义势力。然而，革命依然活着。苏维埃的影响正在扩大，中国各省加入革命队伍的人越来越多。中国革命由共产党人领导，其胜利为期不远。中国革命万岁！

刊登了三张与广州起义有关的照片，附有以下说明：
保卫广州公社——“红色广州的革命示威。那些日子里，街道上组建了劳工防卫队”。
英军在香港登陆——“此处英国帝国主义者集结兵力以镇压中国的革命运动”。
处决广州起义参与者——“‘文明绅士’们出席观看处决”。
蒋介石——“中国革命的刽子手”。

包括俄国在内的全世界共产党现在应为即将到来的中国革命浪潮做好认真准备。“保卫中国革命”应成为各共产党宣传和鼓动的永恒口号。

纪念广州起义周年的集会。

附属于区委的华人支部将于下午6点在五一华人社团举行会议，以纪念广州起义周年。
华人工人在午餐休息期间将就广州起义举行简短集会。
中文报纸《劳工之路》刊登了几篇与广州革命事件有关的历史文章和信息。

符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）市议会选举。

华工选举刘金梅（Liu Chin-Mei，音译）同志为市议会新代表，刘祥吉（Liu Ziang-Chi，音译）同志是他的候选人。

Oct. 22, 1923.

Translation from the 'Krasnoe Znamya' (Red Banner).

Peasant uprising in Thibet and outside interference.

In political respect Thibet is subject to the Dalai-Lama
government only in its south-western part namely Lhassa. The
rest of it such as Jmanbian (south-east) Tsaidam and Kukunor
or Tsinhai (north-east) and the whole of North-Western region
are under China's administration and are governed by Tupans
of different provinces - Szechuen, Kiangsu and Sinkiang, which
officially come under the power of Koumingtang.
The Nationalist Government of Nanking, being now engrossed
in the idea of "centralization" of power and extension of its
influence in the whole of China is, to all appearances, endeavour-
ing to establish relations with the Dalai-Lama Government and
offer the latter assistance in the suppression of the peasant
uprising in Thibet. Koumingtang suppressing mass movements
in China wishes to aid Lhassa, but practically Nanking is not
in a position to assist the government of Thibet owing to
large distances and small financial resources. Consequently
all efforts of the Koumingtang may be regarded as a diplomatic
move only with a view to exhibiting the prestige of its power
before the world.
Lhassa is not at all inclined to submit to Koumingtang;
plans foreseeing that whilst they cannot be of much help in
the suppression of peasant uprising, they may reduce the
independence which is now enjoyed by the Dalai-Lama Government
with respect to China.
Lhassa has not yet forgotten the struggle of many years'
duration between it and China, the latter attempting to govern
Thibet by sending military expeditions to conquer Thibetan
territories.
England is showing great anxiety over the peasant movement
in Thibet firstly because this movement is a "bad example" for
the population in neighbourly India under British yoke. Therefore
should the punitive detachments of Thibetan government succeed
in pushing the rioters towards the border of India, the latter
would have found themselves between two fires as the border
regiments of British Colonial troops in India would not stop
under the pretext of "protecting" their borders to fire at
the rioters from their machine guns and tanks. On the other
hand, however, British imperialists will probably try and make
good use of the uprising in Thibet by increasing their influence
in Lhassa, taking advantage of the difficulties experienced
by the Dalai-Lama Government.
There is also a possibility of sending British expeditionary
forces to Thibet to "re-establish" peace and good order in the
regions affected by the uprisings, thereby extending British
influence in Thibet, the beginning of which was in the eighties
of last century.
Thibet has been for a long time the object of double
attention namely of England and China, periodically supported
by the Imperial Russia. Through a number of conventions and
agreements with China and Russia, British imperialism has been
endeavouring to take up a domineering commercial and political
position in Thibet, which finally was reached to some
considerable extent.
Peaceful relations exist between Afghanistan and Lhassa
and from this quarter Thibet does not fear any plots. However
the hopes of Thibet invariably turn towards the border of
Soviet Russia. It is from here - the Soviet Turkestan -
that Thibet, apart from expecting any plots, sees friendly
spirit and a natural opposition to the covetous pressure by
British imperialism.

IV. Privaloff

Tientsin, October 1923.

译自《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

西藏的农民起义与外部干涉。

在政治方面，西藏仅在其西南部，即拉萨地区，受达赖喇嘛政府管辖。其余地区，如Jmanbian（东南）、柴达木和库库诺尔或青海（东北）以及整个西北地区，均处于中国行政管辖之下，由四川、江苏和新疆等不同省份的督军治理，这些省份在名义上隶属于国民党权力之下。
南京国民政府目前正专注于权力的“集中化”并将其影响力扩展至全中国，表面上正努力与达赖喇嘛政府建立关系，并向后者提供援助，以镇压西藏的农民起义。国民党在中国镇压群众运动，希望援助拉萨，但实际上，由于距离遥远且财政资源匮乏，南京无力援助西藏政府。因此，国民党的所有努力只能被视为一种外交举动，旨在向世界展示其权力威望。
拉萨根本无意顺从国民党；拉萨方面的计划预见到，国民党虽然在镇压农民起义方面帮不上多大忙，但可能会削弱达赖喇嘛政府目前相对于中国所享有的独立性。
拉萨尚未忘记其与中国之间持续多年的斗争，当时中国试图通过派遣军事远征队征服西藏领土来统治西藏。
英国对西藏的农民运动表现出极大的焦虑，首先是因为这一运动对于英属印度邻近地区的民众来说是一个“坏榜样”。因此，如果西藏政府的惩罚性分队成功将暴动者驱赶至印度边境，后者将发现自己陷入两面夹击的境地，因为驻印度的英国殖民部队边境团会以“保护”边境为借口，不停止使用机枪和坦克向暴动者开火。然而，另一方面，英国帝国主义者可能会利用达赖喇嘛政府面临的困难，趁机增加其在拉萨的影响力，从而充分利用西藏的起义。
也有可能派遣英国远征军前往西藏，在受起义影响的地区“恢复”和平与秩序，从而扩大英国在西藏的影响力，这种影响力的开端可追溯至上世纪八十年代。
长期以来，西藏一直是英国和中国双重关注的对象，并偶尔得到沙皇俄国的支持。通过与中国和俄国签订的一系列公约和协定，英国帝国主义一直试图在西藏占据主导性的商业和政治地位，并在一定程度上最终实现了这一目标。
阿富汗与拉萨之间存在和平关系，西藏并不担心来自该方向的任何阴谋。然而，西藏的希望始终转向苏维埃俄国的边境。正是从这里——苏维埃突厥斯坦——西藏除了不期待任何阴谋外，还看到了友好的精神以及对英国帝国主义贪婪压力的天然抵制。

IV. Privaloff

天津，1923年10月。

The "bread crisis" which Vladivostock experienced last spring ,
has not yet taught us how to combat it. At the present time, the
situation is analogous : there is a sufficient quantity of flour and
at the same time there exists the inability to organise its distri -
bution among the population. The queues of people waiting for
bread at the bakeries have again appeared in Vladivostock. The popu-
lation is panic-stricken and has already began to prepare rusks
from bread as a stock against possible shortage.
At present the quantity of bread prepared daily by the bakeries
is quite sufficient to meet the daily needs of the population.
There is also a considerable improvement in the quality of the
bread, though a difference still remains between the bread baked
by the Cooperative and that prepared by private bakers, the latter
producing bread of better quality. The hospitals are besieged with
people suffering from acute stomach disorders and requesting a
doctor's prescriptions for white flour. White flour is obtainable
only by doctors prescriptions at a rate of 3½ kilogrammes per head.-

D. C P. , D. C. J.

Rumours and gossip about the lack of flour for bakeries felt
during the last few days in this town have absolutely no foundation.

The amount of flour supplied daily to the bakeries has not been
reduced even by a single pood. As against 530 bags of flour of various
brands which were formerly supplied to 61 bakeries existing in Vladi-
vostock, 550 bags, making an increase of 20 bags, are now being
delivered daily.

In spite of this however, a stoppage and also irregular distri -
bution of bread have been reported from various parts of the town.
For instance, the day before yesterday the longest queues of customers
waiting for bread were seen in various sections of the town. The
influx of customers was so great that only half a loaf could be
supplied to each customer. In this manner we supplied satisfied
610 customers with 305 loaves of bread. But the stock of bread lasted
for one hour only. At 3 o'clock in the afternoon there was no bread
in the shops and many customers were with empty hands.-

W. C. J.

THE OSAKA MAINICHI & THE TOKYO NICHI NICHI, OSAKA, TUESDAY, AUGUST 21. 1928
（印：JAPANESE POLICE. C.I.D. OSAKA No 10 9199 3. 9. 28）

Nicholas Krylenko
Chief Public Prosecutor Noted For 'Shakhty Trial' to Join Soviet-German Pamir Expedition.

MOSCOW.—The irrepressible Nicholas Krylenko, chief public prosecutor for the Soviet government and for years now the dreaded Nemesis of counter-revolutionaries, is resting from the strenuous labours of the trial which he recently conducted against 50 Russian and three German coal-mining technicians by taking a leading role in an even more strenuous enterprise—the exploration of the mysterious Pamir regions.

Krylenko during the two months' course of the "Shakhty trial" became a familiar—and rather notorious—figure to the newspaper reading public of Germany. His official duties having obliged him to act vigorously against the three German subjects brought to trial by the police and judicial organs of the country, his figure naturally appeared in a harsh and unfavourable light in the German press.

By a curious turn of affairs, however, he is now linked in comradeship with a group of Germans in this Pamir undertaking. With them he must share the hardships, the dangers and the thrills which the Soviet-German Pamir-Darvaz Expedition, recently started, is sure to encounter.

Krylenko's plans to take part in the expedition were formulated many months ago. He is a member of the Soviet Society of Alpinists and an enthusiastic explorer. Indeed, his primary talents are not merely intellectual, he is reputed to excel in sports of various types, particularly in horsemanship, and his first achievements for the Bolshevik revolution were in the military field.

Connected With 'Izvestia'

But while arranged for long before the Donetz affair was thought about, Krylenko's participation in this joint German and Soviet adventure will nevertheless serve to soften the harsh picture of him in the public mind of Germany. He is acting as special correspondent on the expedition for the official government organ, "Izvestia," and the world will watch what promises to be a superb drama of daring and perseverance in large measure through his eyes.

The idea of investigating the almost unknown Pamir-Darvaz section as an international co-operative effort originated several years ago, during the bi-centennary celebration of the Russian Academy of Sciences. The German meteorologist, Prof. Ficker, is credited with having made the suggestion and has been active in the planning ever since, but was prevented from participating personally. In Germany the work was also encouraged by the Society for the Promotion of Scientific Research, and particularly by its president, Prof. Schmidt-Ott.

Among the German scientists and experienced alpinists is Prof. Rickers, who explored the western part of the Pamir, in the Tadjik Mountains, in 1910.

The Russian side of the undertaking is headed by P. Gorbunov, of the Society of Alpinists. It includes Prof. N. L. Korzhenevsky of the Central Asiatic University, one of the leading authorities on the Pamir; the meteorologist R. R. Zimmerman; Academician D. I. Stcheibakov, a prominent geologist; J. I. Belyayev, an astronomer; and the zoologist A. N. Reichart.

Its Sporting Character

Primarily scientific in scope, the expedition also has a distinctly sporting character. The German and Soviet alpinists include men who are fervent explorers for exploration's sake. Krylenko is one of these. But all of them will have a function in the gathering of scientific data in the domains of general geography, geodesy, botany, anthropology, etc. A council of German and Soviet scholars has been chosen by the Academy of Sciences to study the materials which will be gathered by the expedition. The costs of the undertaking will be apportioned between the two countries in accordance with the number of people taking part.

The mountainous area of Pamir-Darvaz—often referred to as "the roof of the world"—covering some 5,000 square kilometers will be the scene of the expedition's efforts. Previous attempts to penetrate this region have usually ended in failure, but the present more ambitious and better-organized enterprise promises to overcome the unusually baffling difficulties. One of the highest mountain ranges in the world, some of whose peaks reach a height of 7,500 meters above sea level and have never been ascended, is in this area. The region is inhabited by strange and almost unknown tribes.
—(U.P.)

D. C. J.

（印：日本警察。刑事调查处 大阪 编号 10 9199 3. 9. 28）

尼古拉·克雷连科
以“沙赫特审判”闻名的首席检察官将加入苏德帕米尔探险队。

莫斯科讯——不知疲倦的尼古拉·克雷连科，苏联政府首席检察官，多年来一直是反革命分子畏惧的复仇女神，最近因主持对50名俄罗斯和3名德国采矿技术人员的审判而辛勤工作，现正通过在一项更为艰苦的事业——探索神秘的帕米尔地区——中担任主要角色来进行休整。

在为期两个月的“沙赫特审判”期间，克雷连科成为德国读报公众熟悉——且相当臭名昭著——的人物。由于他的职务要求他对被该国警察和司法机关起诉的三名德国公民采取严厉行动，他的形象在德国媒体中自然显得严酷且不受欢迎。

然而，出于某种奇特的转折，他现在在这项帕米尔行动中一群德国人结成了同志关系。他必须与他们共同分担近期启动的苏德帕米尔-达尔瓦兹探险队注定会遇到的艰辛、危险和刺激。

克雷连科参加探险队的计划早在数月前就已制定。他是苏联登山协会的成员，也是一位热情的探险家。事实上，他的主要才能不仅仅在于智力，据说他在各种体育运动方面都很出色，尤其是马术，而他为布尔什维克革命做出的最初贡献是在军事领域。

与《消息报》有关联

虽然早在顿涅茨事件发生之前很久就安排好了，但克雷连科参与这次德苏联合冒险行动仍将有助于缓和他在德国民众心中的严酷形象。他作为官方政府机关报《消息报》的特派记者参与此次探险，世界将通过他的眼睛见证这场有望成为勇敢与毅力绝佳篇章的戏剧。

调查几乎未知的帕米尔-达尔瓦兹地区作为国际合作努力的想法起源于几年前，正值俄罗斯科学院二百周年庆典期间。德国气象学家菲克尔（Ficker）教授被认为提出了这一建议，并一直积极参与规划，但未能亲自参加。在德国，这项工作也得到了科学研究促进协会，特别是其主席施密特-奥特（Schmidt-Ott）教授的鼓励。

德国科学家和经验丰富的登山家中包括里克斯（Rickers）教授，他于1910年勘探了塔吉克山脉中帕米尔的西部。

此次行动的俄方由登山协会的P.戈尔布诺夫（P. Gorbunov）领导。成员包括中亚大学的N. L.科尔热涅夫斯基（N. L. Korzhenevsky）教授，他是帕米尔问题的主要权威之一；气象学家R. R.齐默尔曼（R. R. Zimmerman）；著名地质学家、院士D. I.谢伊巴科夫（D. I. Stcheibakov）；天文学家J. I.别利亚耶夫（J. I. Belyayev）；以及动物学家A. N.赖夏特（A. N. Reichart）。

其体育性质

此次探险主要以科学为目的，但也具有明显的体育性质。德国和苏联登山家中包括那些纯粹为了探险而热衷探险的人。克雷连科就是其中之一。但他们所有人都将在收集一般地理、大地测量学、植物学、人类学等领域的科学数据方面发挥作用。科学院已选定一个由德国和苏联学者组成的委员会，以研究探险队收集的材料。此次行动的费用将根据参与人数在两国之间分摊。

帕米尔-达尔瓦兹山区——常被称为“世界屋脊”——覆盖面积约5,000平方公里，将是探险队努力的舞台。此前渗透该地区的尝试通常以失败告终，但这次规模更大、组织更好的行动有望克服异常令人困惑的困难。世界上最高的山脉之一位于该地区，其中一些山峰海拔高达7,500米，且从未有人登顶。该地区居住着奇怪且几乎未知的部落。
—（合众社 U.P.）

D. C. J.
