29.6.29.
Left Wing of the Japanese Labour Movement and the
Pan Pacific Conference in Vladivostock.

The Left Wing of the Labour Movement in Japan is one of
the most prominent and active bodies of the labour class
connected with the Pan Pacific Secretariat.
The Japanese labour movement numbering about 300.000
organized members is not confined to one association. It is
divided into numerous small unions and different political
alienations such as the Right Reformatory, the Medium and
the Left Movements. In the first mentioned the Sodomei
Federation holds most prominent place with Suzuki, who is
well known in the Far East, at the head, the Japanese calling
him Hompers. There are about 30.000 members of the Sodomei.
In addition to the above there are other reformatory inclined
organizations namely The Japanese Seamen's Union (54 thousand
members), The Arsenal Workers' Federation (40.000 members)
and Federation of the Workers of State Concerns (13.000 members).
All these organizations by December 1928 formed a joint
body known as "The League of the Right Wing" just about
the time of Albert Thomas' visit to Japan. This league
numbers about 150.000 organized workers, which makes up for
half the whole of the organized proletariat of Japan.
Politically they support the Social Democratic Party known
as the Siakai Minsuto, which is a bourgeois inclined Party.
Then comes the Medium organization which differs but
little from the Reformatory. The League of this latter
is known as "Kumiai Domei" and numbers about 50.000 members.
The Party it supports is the Nihon Taisuto (Japanese Masses
Party). This is a social democratic party of semi-foreign
style.
With reference to members of the above organization
it is well to note that whilst the leaders entertain
"right" tendencies the masses of Medium organizations
are inclined more to the "left". This dissension is
very welcome to the left wing of the Japanese labour
movement.
What is the left wing of the Japanese Labour Movement?
There are at present 90 "left" unions in Japan in various
branches of industry. These unions were united by the
central organization known as the Hiogikai, numbering about
35 to 40 thousand organized workers. Hiogikai is the
organizing centre for revolutionary oppositions in the
ranks of the two first mentioned organizations. Hiogikai
and the whole of the revolutionary Opposition compose
the League of Unity (Toitzu Domei) which numbers about
100.000 members. This number makes up the revolutionary
army of the Left Wing of the Japanese Labour Movement.
Hiogikai and Toutzu Domei politically are closely connected
with the Peasant and Labour Party known as the Rodo Nominto,
which is more numerous and influential in the Japanese
labour masses than the social democratic Party referred to.
HIOGIKAI and TOITSU DOMEI were the organizations of
the Japanese Proletariat, which took an active part both
in the formation of the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions and in its subsequent activities.
The success of the Left Wing amongst Japanese labour
masses frightened Japanese capitalists and the Japanese
Government. After effecting numerous arrests of communists
and members of the revolutionary labour movement in March
of 1928 the Japanese Government issued orders to
close down the Hiogikai and Rodo Nominto Party, hoping
thereby to disorganize the revolutionary proletarian
movement in Japan. Leaders of Rodo Nominto made several

29.6.29。
日本劳工运动的左翼与符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的泛太平洋会议。

日本劳工运动的左翼是与泛太平洋书记处联系最紧密、最为突出和活跃的工人阶级团体之一。
拥有约300,000名组织成员的日本劳工运动并不局限于一个协会。它分为众多小型工会和不同的政治派别，如右翼改良派、中间派和左翼运动。在上述第一个派别中，总同盟（Sodomei Federation）占据最突出的地位，由在远东颇有名气的铃木（Suzuki）领导，日本人称他为“皇帝”（Hompers）。总同盟约有30,000名成员。
除上述组织外，还有其他倾向于改良主义的组织，即日本海员工会（54,000名成员）、兵工厂工人联合会（40,000名成员）和国营企业工人联合会（13,000名成员）。
所有这些组织在1928年12月组建了一个联合机构，称为“右翼联盟”，这正值阿尔伯特·托马斯（Albert Thomas）访问日本之际。该联盟拥有约150,000名组织工人，占日本整个有组织无产阶级的一半。
在政治上，他们支持被称为社会民权党（Siakai Minsuto）的社会民主党，这是一个倾向资产阶级的政党。
接下来是中间组织，其与改良派的差别微乎其微。后者的联盟称为“组合同盟”（Kumiai Domei），拥有约50,000名成员。
它所支持的政党是日本大众党（Nihon Taisuto）。这是一个具有半外国风格的社会民主党。
关于上述组织的成员，值得注意的是，虽然领导人持有“右”倾倾向，但中间组织的群众更倾向于“左”。这种分歧非常符合日本劳工运动左翼的利益。
什么是日本劳工运动的左翼？
目前日本各行业有90个“左翼”工会。这些工会由名为评议会（Hiogikai）的中心组织联合起来，拥有约35,000至40,000名组织工人。评议会是前两个提到的组织内部革命反对派的组织中心。评议会和整个革命反对派组成了统一联盟（Toitzu Domei），拥有约100,000名成员。这一数字构成了日本劳工运动左翼的革命军队。
评议会和统一联盟在政治上与农民劳动党（Rodo Nominto）有着密切的联系，该党在日本劳工群众中比前述社会民主党拥有更多成员和更大影响力。
评议会和统一联盟是日本无产阶级的组织，它们积极参与了泛太平洋工会书记处的成立及其后续活动。
左翼在日本劳工群众中的成功使日本资本家和日本政府感到恐惧。在1928年3月大规模逮捕共产党人和革命劳工运动成员后，日本政府下令关闭评议会和农民劳动党，希望以此瓦解日本的革命无产阶级运动。农民劳动党的领导人进行了几次

attempts to re-establish legally the "left" peasant and
labour Party, but the authorities suppressed it each time.
However, the Japanese Authorities, did not succeed to
disorganize the revolutionary labour movement. The number
of revolutionaries grows inspite of the imprisonment of
Japanese communists, which fact is even admitted by the
bourgeois press.
The Left Wing Japanese labour movement continues to
extend despite the closing down of the Hiogikao and its
influence on the labour masses of Japan is as strong as ever
although the Right Reformists and the Medium Section are
making every effort to gain monopoly in the Japanese Labour
Movement.
Repressions by the Japanese Government against
the revolutionary elements of labour movement alongside
the unsatisfactory economic situation of the Japanese
proletariat caused by capitalistic rationalization, are
like water being poured over the wheels of the revolutionary
movement of Japanese labourers. The Left Wing Japanese
Labour Movement will continue to be foremost in the ranks
of the revolutionary Pan Pacific Labour Movement, which is
being grouped around the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions. Its participation in the forthcoming Pan Pacific
Labour Conference in Vladivostock is one of the conditions
of the successful work of this Conference.
HAIYAMA.

合法重建“左翼”农民和劳动党的尝试，但当局每次都予以镇压。
然而，日本当局未能瓦解革命劳工运动。尽管日本共产党人被监禁，革命者的人数仍在增长，连资产阶级报纸也承认这一事实。
尽管评议会被关闭，日本劳工运动的左翼继续扩展，其对日本劳工群众的影响力依然强劲，尽管右翼改良派和中间派正竭尽全力试图垄断日本劳工运动。
日本政府对劳工运动革命分子的镇压，加上资本主义合理化导致的日本无产阶级经济状况不佳，如同给日本劳工革命运动的车轮浇水一般（意指助燃或推动）。日本劳工运动左翼将继续处于围绕泛太平洋工会书记处集结的革命泛太平洋劳工运动的前列。其参加即将在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）举行的泛太平洋劳工会议，是该会议工作取得成功的条件之一。
白山（HAIYAMA）。

尽管评议会被关闭，日本劳工运动继续扩展，其对日本劳工群众的影响力依然强劲，尽管右翼改良派和管理层正竭尽全力试图垄断日本劳工运动。
日本政府对劳工运动革命分子的镇压，加上资本主义合理化导致的日本无产阶级经济状况不佳，如同给日本劳工革命运动的车轮浇水一般。任何真正的劳工运动的前景都将在围绕泛太平洋贸易工会书记处集结的革命泛太平洋劳工运动行列中被预见。其参加即将在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）举行的泛太平洋劳工会议，是该会议工作取得成功的条件之一。

Translation from the "Russkoe Slovo" (Russian Word) published
in Harbin dated January 16, 1929.

New adventure of Mr. Moravsky.

Mr. Moravsky, whose name is widely known in the Far East,
is the centre of political (Russian) attention in Shanghai
at present. A great many adventures are connected with his name.
Moravsky participated in the uprising of Czech General Gaida
in Vladivostock against Gen. Sazonoff. At that time he was
saved by the Americans. Later on Moravsky joins the Siberian
Autonomists and gets round the old man Sazonoff, who is honest
and an idealist, and involves the latter in the case of printing
non-existent Siberian Government stamps. This happened in
Shanghai where a printing office was established and samples
of the stamps are ready when at the request of the Soviet
Consul General, the French authorities raided the printing
office, confiscated the stamps in question and arrested the
persons concerned including Mr. Moravsky. As a result the
latter was expelled from the French Concession and shortly
afterwards Mr. Sazonoff died. It still remains a mystery what
was the idea of printing those stamps. It is alleged that either
Moravsky wanted to sell them to American stamp collectors or
compromise thereby the Siberian Autonomous movement.

Mr. Moravsky continued activities, interviewed on some
unknown matters foreigners, travelled to Japan and attempted
to get Podtiaguin's funds there, styled himself the head of
the Representatives of Siberian Autonomous Organizations,
promised various concessions to Americans and Japanese if
these latter would help in the movement "to free Siberia
from the Bolsheviks," and in general made his existence
on the strength of the "Siberian Autonomy".

In the spring of 1928 Mr. A. P. Golovacheff, who is the
leader of the Siberian Autonomous movement, having found
activities of Mr. Moravsky somewhat suspicious, when in Shanghai
excluded Mr. Moravsky from membership of the Representatives
of the Siberian Autonomous Organizations. At the time Mr.
Golovacheff reminded Mr. Moravsky of his political actions,
referred to his connection with the murder of one Vereteliak,
pointed out the way Moravsky disposed of the funds belonging
to the Organization and called the case with the stamps as
an act of provocation. It would seem as though after all the
above the career of Mr. Moravsky would end, but he still
continues to be "active". Only recently he issued two
publications in the form of appeals in Shanghai signed by
the Council of Representatives, etc. In these appeals Mr.
Moravsky calls upon people to join the movement to free
Siberia, as being a country on the advance line. The question
arises what makes Mr. Moravsky issue these appeals in Shanghai
which is pretty far from the advance line? The matter is
quite simple. Mr. Moravsky needs to prove that he is at the
head of a strong organization which has supporters in the
Far East and Siberia and means thereby to mislead some other
foreigners with a view to obtaining money.

Amongst foreigners there are often people made easily to
believe or simply actuated by avarice that with Russians
one can do anything and even obtain concessions, railways, etc.
for trifling sums of money.

Moravsky at present is spreading the rumour in Shanghai
that American capitalists are ready to finance him and his
Council of Representatives of Siberian Autonomous Organizations
to the extent of 15 million Gold dollars if only he agrees
to grant them concessions as follows:- 99 years on the Ussuri
Railway, 43 years on Suchan Mines and also Fishing Concessions
etc. Moravsky "agreed" to all that, but told the Americans

译自1929年1月16日哈尔滨出版的《Russkoe Slovo》（俄语意为“俄罗斯言论”）。

莫拉夫斯基先生的新冒险。

莫拉夫斯基先生，其名字在远东广为人知，目前是上海政治（俄罗斯）关注的中心。许多冒险活动都与他的名字联系在一起。莫拉夫斯基曾参与捷克盖达将军（General Gaida）在海参崴反对萨佐诺夫将军（Gen. Sazonoff）的起义。当时他得到了美国人的救助。后来，莫拉夫斯基加入了西伯利亚自治派，并欺骗了诚实且理想主义的老人萨佐诺夫，使后者卷入印刷根本不存在的西伯利亚政府邮票的案件。此事发生在上海，当时一家印刷所已经建立，邮票样本也已准备就绪，此时应苏联总领事的要求，法国当局突袭了该印刷所，没收了相关邮票，并逮捕了包括莫拉夫斯基先生在内的相关人员。结果，后者被驱逐出法租界，不久后萨佐诺夫先生去世。印刷这些邮票的目的究竟为何，至今仍是个谜。据称，要么是莫拉夫斯基想将它们卖给美国的集邮者，要么是想以此破坏西伯利亚自治运动。

莫拉夫斯基继续活动，就一些不明事项采访外国人，前往日本，试图在那里获取波德佳金（Podtiaguin）的资金，自称为西伯利亚自治组织代表委员会主席，承诺如果美国人及日本人帮助“将西伯利亚从布尔什维克手中解放出来”的运动，将给予他们各种特许权，总之，他是依靠“西伯利亚自治”的名义维持生存。

1928年春，西伯利亚自治运动的领导人A. P. 戈洛瓦切夫（A. P. Golovacheff）先生发现莫拉夫斯基先生的活动有些可疑，当其在上海时，将莫拉夫斯基先生排除在西伯利亚自治组织代表委员会的成员之外。当时，戈洛瓦切夫先生提醒莫拉夫斯基注意其政治行动，提及他与一起谋杀维列捷利亚克（Vereteliak）案件的关联，指出莫拉夫斯基处置属于该组织资金的方式，并称邮票案件为挑衅行为。看来在上述一切之后，莫拉夫斯基先生的生涯本该终结，但他仍然继续“活跃”。就在最近，他在上海以代表委员会等名义签署并发布了两份呼吁书形式的出版物。在这些呼吁书中，莫拉夫斯基先生号召人们加入解放西伯利亚的运动，称其为处于前线的国家。这就产生了一个问题：是什么促使莫拉夫斯基先生在距离前线相当遥远的上海发布这些呼吁书？事情很简单。莫拉夫斯基需要证明他领导着一个在远东和西伯利亚拥有支持者的强大组织，并以此误导其他外国人，旨在获取资金。

在外国人中，经常有一些人容易轻信，或者仅仅受贪婪驱使，认为与俄罗斯人打交道可以做成任何事，甚至只需花费微不足道的金额就能获得特许权、铁路等。

莫拉夫斯基目前在上海散布谣言，称美国资本家愿意资助他和他的西伯利亚自治组织代表委员会，金额高达1500万金美元，只要他同意授予他们如下特许权：乌苏里铁路99年特许权，苏昌煤矿43年特许权，以及渔业特许权等。莫拉夫斯基“同意”了所有这些条件，但告诉美国人

page_data.en:
- 2 -

that it was necessary to obtain the consent of the Japanese
and was assured that the Americans would approach the
Japanese themselves.
Friends of Mr. Moravsky assert that in spring of next
year he will have a man-of-war at his disposal and a
submarine with which he will begin to attack the Russian territory
with a view to establishing his power there as chief of the
government and then begin the distribution of railways, mines,
etc., to foreigners.
Messrs. Chertkoff, who resides in Japan, Z., an engineer
M., a General and J. a lawyer are said to be Moravsky's
followers and assistants. Moravsky is proceeding to Peking
and will then go to Harbin, Mukden and other places to
prepare for the campaign in the Primorie.
The whole information would appear fantastic were it
not for the fact that it is actuated by provocation and is
meant to compromise Russian emigration in the eyes of foreign
business circles.
As far as we are aware Mr. Moravsky's activities do
not meet with the approval of the Siberian autonomists, who
are pursuing their plans in the Far East and Siberia in a
quiet manner.

说必须获得日本的同意，并确信美国人会自行与日本人接触。
莫拉夫斯基的朋友声称，明年春天他将拥有一艘军舰和一艘潜艇可供支配，他将利用这些武器开始攻击俄罗斯领土，旨在在那里建立其作为政府首脑的权力，然后开始向外国人分配铁路、矿山等。
据说居住在日本的切尔特科夫（Chertkoff）先生、工程师Z.、M.将军和律师J.是莫拉夫斯基的追随者和助手。莫拉夫斯基正前往北京，随后将前往哈尔滨、沈阳等地，为在滨海边疆区（Primorie）的行动做准备。
如果不是因为这一切是由挑衅驱动，并意在外国商界眼中损害俄罗斯移民的声誉，整个信息看起来似乎是荒诞不经的。
据我们所知，莫拉夫斯基的活动并未得到西伯利亚自治主义者的认可，后者正在远东和西伯利亚以低调的方式推行他们的计划。

Translation from the "Krasnoe .namya" of October 5 and 4, 1923.

Correspondence from Kobe.

During the recent months Japanese Imperialism is going through difficult times. It has found itself between the hammer and the anvil the first in the form of American imperialism and the second in the shape of Chinese national movement. A very complicated and dangerous situation indeed and with future prospects still more so. Japan's interests in China are very big. The danger threatening them comes from two sides; in the first place from China, which is getting more powerful with every succeeding day, and secondly from the United States which have long since set their eyes on China as a field suitable for their interests.

Washington and Japanese Imperialism have clashed in China. It is a well known fact that when an army finds itself in a difficult situation it endeavours to maintain the position of its advance line. The Japanese imperialism is in exactly the same state of affairs. If forced to retreat owing to circumstances in China, Japanese imperialism will certainly not give up its standing in Manchuria. For the sake of Manchuria Japan will risk anything because the latter has made of Manchuria already a part of economic and political Japanese imperialistic area. Thus Manchuria for the next few years will be the scene of serious international complications and particularly in matters concerning the Pacific Coast.

L. Hamilton.

Reconstruction of Afghanistan.

Extensive and various plans have been drawn up with a view to effecting a thorough reconstruction of Afghanistan. New schools military and civil, clubs, labour institutions etc. will be established and the labour class will be given facilities to learn professions to make them qualified workers. Telegraphic communications will also be established with several places in the neighbourhood as far as Persia.

Translation from the "Izvestia" of October 2nd 1923.

The Institute of Eastern Languages in Leningrad.

The Government Commission of the Institute of Eastern Languages with Comrade Enukidze at the head decided that facilities should be granted to students of the Institute to travel for practice purposes once a year or so to China, Afghanistan, Persia and Turkey. Furthermore it was decided to give definite appointments to graduating students and start a publication "Present Day East".

Comrade A.N. Voznesensky, who was formerly in charge of the Eastern Department of the Commissariat for Foreign Affairs, Member of the Krestintern Council and Tass Correspondent in Japan in 1923, has been appointed Rector of the Institute of Eastern Languages in Leningrad.

来自神户的通讯。

在最近几个月里，日本帝国主义正经历艰难时期。它发现自己处于铁锤和砧板之间，前者是美国帝国主义的形式，后者是中国民族运动的形态。这确实是一个非常复杂和危险的局势，未来的前景更是如此。日本在中国的利益非常大。威胁这些利益的危险来自两个方面；首先来自中国，中国正日益强大；其次来自美国，美国早已将中国视为适合其利益的领域。

华盛顿和日本帝国主义在中国发生了冲突。众所周知，当一支军队陷入困境时，它会努力维持其前线阵地。日本帝国主义正处于完全相同的境地。如果因中国局势所迫而撤退，日本帝国主义肯定不会放弃其在满洲的地位。为了满洲，日本愿意冒任何风险，因为日本已使满洲成为其经济和政治帝国主义区域的一部分。因此，在未来几年内，满洲将成为严重国际并发症的舞台，特别是在涉及太平洋沿岸的事务上。

L. 汉密尔顿。

阿富汗的重建。

为了对阿富汗进行彻底的重建，已经制定了广泛而多样的计划。新的军事和民用学校、俱乐部、劳工机构等将会建立，劳工阶级将获得学习职业技能的机会，使其成为合格的工人。还将建立与周边多个地区（远至波斯）的电报通信。

The "Krasnoe Znamya" of March 5th writes:-
Komintern in the East.

The first five years of the work of Komintern can be
roughly described as a period of open rebellion of the
proletariat in capitalistic countries. The marked feature
of the next five years is the wave of revolutionary uprisings
and skirmishes amongst the colonial nations.
In summing up colonial revolutionary attainments, it is
necessary to mention that nowhere did the revolution of oppressed
nations or rather their masses have a final success and even
where temporary success had been obtained it was soon counter-
acted by the world capitalism. In the course of this process
the colonial revolution whilst developing and striving after
a higher stage of class struggle, came in contact with the
bourgeois wing of open treachery in the national freedom
movement co-operating with imperialism in opposing the proletariat
and peasantry. In other countries it only initiated and stopped
at that without the masses realizing as yet class differentiation.
The co-ordination of the two tendencies of world revolution -
namely proletarian and colonial - has already been attained
in some degree or another in the sense of ideology, class
distinction and politics. Nothing more can be said as where
organizational connection is concerned it is not yet sufficient
to deprive imperialism of technical possibility of dealing
blows to the individual groups and detachments of socialistic
revolution.
The following were the most important events directed
against British imperialism during the second portion of
the ten years:- the general strike of the miners and the
Chinese revolution both of which proceeded on an independent
basis. In dealing with the general strike by bribing its
headquarters and persecuting labour organizations with the
aid of reformists at the time, British imperialism was in a
position to act without looking back at the East. It was
just then that its rear in China and India was threatened
with danger. Following the above Imperialistic England was
able to start on a military intervention in China with ease,
having succeeded in suppressing the activities of labour
organizations and paralyzing the trade unions.
The uprising in Indonesia took place before it had time
to co-ordinate its activities with the revolution in China.
As is known the uprising in Java was suppressed before it
extended to other islands, which in turn were dealt with
at the start by the Dutch troops, already free after the
bloodshed in Java.
The same may be said of the military attacks by the native
tribes of North Africa in 1925 against the French Imperialism
which took place at different periods and which never coincided
with the uprisings in Syria, which latter occurred again at
times different from disturbances in the labour world of France.
Finally the two revolutionary colonial tendencies, whose
destiny it may be to play a decisive role in the next five years,
namely the Chinese and Indian revolutions, although very close
to one another failed to fall in at the height of their
development. The revolutionary wave in India, which has
surpassed anything hitherto known in the sense of labour
masses activity, takes place between the two periods of Chinese
revolution.
There is no reason to conceal or disguise the political,
tactical and organizational mistakes, weaknesses and slips
allowed and committed in the course of colonial strife.
The Sixth Congress of the Komintern in its decisions
and resolutions realized these mistakes to the full extent,
analyzed their causes and sources and formulated in consequence
of these experiences lessons for the future struggle.

3月5日的《Krasnoe Znamya》（红旗报）写道：-
共产国际在东方。

共产国际工作的第一个五年大致可以描述为资本主义国家无产阶级公开反抗的时期。接下来五年的显著特征是殖民国家中革命起义和小规模冲突的浪潮。
在总结殖民地革命成就时，必须指出，受压迫民族的革命，或者更确切地说是其群众的革命，在任何地方都没有取得最终成功，即使在取得暂时成功的地方，也很快被世界资本主义所抵消。在这个过程中，殖民地革命在发展和争取更高阶段的阶级斗争时，接触到了民族自由运动中公开叛变的资产阶级翼，后者与帝国主义合作反对无产阶级和农民。在其他国家，革命仅由此发起并停滞于此，群众尚未意识到阶级分化。世界革命的两种倾向——即无产阶级和殖民地——在意识形态、阶级区分和政治方面已经在某种程度上实现了协调。至于组织联系，无可多言，目前的联系尚不足以剥夺帝国主义对社会主义革命的个别团体和分队进行打击的技术可能性。
在这十年的后半段，针对英国帝国主义的最重要事件如下：矿工大罢工和中国革命，两者均在独立基础上进行。在处理大罢工时，英国帝国主义通过贿赂其总部并借助改良主义者迫害劳工组织，得以在不顾及东方的情况下采取行动。正是在那时，其在中国和印度的后方受到了危险威胁。继此之后，帝国主义的英国能够轻易地开始对中国的军事干预，因为它成功镇压了劳工组织的活动并使工会瘫痪。
印度尼西亚的起义发生得过早，来不及将其活动与中国革命协调起来。众所周知，爪哇的起义在蔓延到其他岛屿之前就被镇压了，而其他岛屿则在爪哇流血事件结束后，随即被荷兰军队处理。
1925年北非土著部落对法国帝国主义的军事攻击也是如此，这些攻击发生在不同时期，从未与叙利亚的起义重合，而叙利亚的起义又与法国劳工界的动荡发生在不同时间。
最后，两种革命性的殖民地倾向，其命运可能是在未来五年发挥决定性作用，即中国和印度革命，虽然彼此非常接近，但未能在其发展的高峰期同步。印度的革命浪潮，就劳工群众活动的意义而言，超过了以往已知的任何情况，发生在中国革命的两个时期之间。
没有理由隐瞒或掩饰在殖民地斗争过程中允许和犯下的政治、战术和组织上的错误、弱点和失误。
共产国际第六次代表大会在其决定和决议中充分认识到这些错误，分析了其原因和根源，并根据这些经验教训制定了未来斗争的方针。

The Chinese revolution was an especially serious
fore-warning to imperialism. In the days of victory
of the Shanghai labourers it became clear to everyone,
to friends as well as enemies, that the Chinese revolution
has tackled the knot of the imperialistic system as a whole.
A decisive victory in this point would have meant a deathly
blow to the system in question. Then followed the mobilization
of all weapons of the world imperialism in order to attain
success in Shanghai and defend the "prestige", i.e. the "right"
of colonial plundering in the whole of the East.
It is only now that we see what diplomatic efforts,
what co-operation the imperialists showed in the days of
Shanghai and Wuhan trouble in order to unify their actions
for the defeat of the Chinese revolution. The wide masses
of European and American proletariat can now see for themselves
that the reformists in all countries concerned and particularly
in England, having supported imperialism, thereby repeated
the treachery of 1914.
Indian revolution will have against it a united world
imperialism in a different form to that of the Chinese,
as the colonial monopoly of England arouses mad jealousy
on the part of American capitalists. The colonial revolution
will know how to take advantage of the conflicts and disagreements in the camp of imperialists only after it has won and
secured serious success. This change in the situation will
happen so as to improve the tasks of the colonial revolution
only as a result of an open military encounter in the midst
of the imperialists, in other words after a new world war.

( The above is an extract from an article published in
No. 9-10 of the "Communistic International" Journal. )

中国革命对帝国主义来说是一个特别严重的预警。在上海工人胜利的日子里，无论是朋友还是敌人，大家都清楚地看到，中国革命已经抓住了整个帝国主义体系的关键结。在这一关键点上的决定性胜利，将意味着对该体系的致命打击。随后，世界帝国主义动员了其所有武器，以便在上海取得成功并捍卫其“威望”，即在整个东方进行殖民掠夺的“权利”。

直到现在我们才看到，在上海和武汉动荡期间，帝国主义者为了统一行动以击败中国革命，展现了怎样的外交努力和合作。欧美广大无产阶级现在可以亲眼看到，有关各国、特别是英国的改良主义者支持了帝国主义，从而重演了1914年的背叛行径。

印度革命所面对的将是另一种形式的世界帝国主义联合阵线，这与中国的处境不同，因为英国的殖民垄断引起了美国资本家的疯狂嫉妒。殖民革命只有在赢得并确保取得重大成功之后，才知道如何利用帝国主义阵营内部的冲突和分歧。这种局势的变化，只有作为帝国主义内部公开军事遭遇的结果——换句话说，即在新一轮世界大战之后——才会发生，从而改善殖民革命的任务。

（以上摘录自《共产国际》杂志第9-10期发表的一篇文章。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C.I.D RECORDS
No 2.76...9199
Date 26.4.29

Translation from the "Izvestia" of March 23,
Imperialists on Soviet Cognizance of the East

The weakest spot of the imperialistic world is the East and colonies. The powerful movement of Eastern countries to obtain their freedom is undermining the very foundation of the strength of world capitalism. In spite of the temporary defeat of the Chinese revolution and the alternative success and failure of revolutionary movements in other colonies and semi-colonies and in particular in India - this "best gem of the British Crown" - imperialism continues to feel keenly the threat to its existence in colonies.

For the success of the freedom movement in the East the existence and prosperity of Soviet Russia is of vital importance. The example of a country, opposed to the united frontier of imperialists, is a thing which holds the attention and hopes of the oppressed masses of the East and of the whole world and mobilizes forces from amongst these masses for revolutionary activities. In order to understand the important part of this, one of its kind, Soviet country it is but necessary to see with what fear and hatred our common enemies watch everything that happens in Russia, taking for example, the study of the East, its revolutionary movement and the surroundings in which it is developing.

"Revolution in the East". "Soviet plans in the Colonies". Such are the headings under which "The Times", the most powerful organ of British imperialism, in its issue of February 15 gives space to one and a half column to describe the work of the Soviet study of the East. This description begins by reference to Soviet Russia "turning to the East so as to conquer the West with its aid" and an assertion to the effect that the Soviet Government clearly sees the weakness of European capitalism namely the colonies and is attacking this capitalism through the East. With this end in view U.S.S.R. "making use of the Imperialistic Russia institutions" has re-organized Eastern schools and established a "department of propaganda in different languages". "Where, at the time of the old regime, students of the Orient, official interpreters and diplomats had their education, communists are now teaching propagandists and professional revolutionaries".

Further description is somewhat after the style of Rockamball(?) . The British newspaper finds three centres "of communist propaganda in the East" - Vladivostock, Tashkent and Moscow. In Vladivostock, for instance, there is a radio station of power enabling the Komintern to send reports to Japan, China and even Dutch Indies and "get young Malays to come to Vladivostock to learn the art of civil war". In Tashkent the correspondent of "The Times" finds several institutions "working out ways and means of penetrating India and Afghanistan". The attention of the above paper, full of fear, is centred, amidst other things, on the "Bulletin of Asia-Minor Press", published in Tashkent, the fault of which lies in printing a quotation of Lenin and in its first issue in calling upon readers to study the question of the East with systematic attention.

The greatest impression is, however, made on the correspondent by the Moscow way of dealing with Eastern matters. As for instance "Representatives of coloured races, invited to Moscow, are given an example of authority and the prosperity of the Red Comrades". Negroes are shown old palaces and are allowed to sit on Imperial thrones. Then these thus spoiled coloured natives are sent to study in the University of Stalin. The more capable pupils are taken on as aspirants into scientific associations for 80 Rls a month, board and lodging.

上海公共租界工部局
刑事侦缉处档案
编号 2.76...9199
日期 1929年4月26日

译自3月23日《消息报》，
帝国主义者眼中的苏维埃对东方的认知

帝国主义世界最薄弱的环节是东方和殖民地。东方国家争取自由的强大运动正在动摇世界资本主义力量的根基。尽管中国革命暂时受挫，其他殖民地和半殖民地（特别是印度——这颗“大英帝国皇冠上最好的宝石”）的革命运动成败交替，但帝国主义继续敏锐地感受到其在殖民地的生存所受到的威胁。

苏维埃俄国的存在和繁荣，对于东方自由运动的成功至关重要。作为一个与帝国主义联合战线相对立的国家，其榜样吸引着东方及全世界被压迫群众的关注和希望，并从这些群众中动员力量进行革命活动。要理解这个独一无二的苏维埃国家所起的重要作用，只需看看我们的共同敌人是以怎样的恐惧和仇恨注视着俄罗斯发生的一切，例如他们对东方研究、其革命运动及其发展环境的关注。

“东方革命”。“苏维埃在殖民地的计划”。英国帝国主义最有力的喉舌《泰晤士报》在2月15日的版面上，用一栏半的篇幅描述了苏维埃对东方的研究工作，标题即是如此。这篇描述开篇便称苏维埃俄国“转向东方，以便借助东方征服西方”，并断言苏维埃政府清楚地看到了欧洲资本主义的弱点，即殖民地，并通过东方攻击这一资本主义。为此目的，苏联“利用帝俄时期的机构”重组了东方学校，并建立了“多语种宣传部门”。“在旧政权时期，东方学生、官方翻译和外交官接受教育的地方，现在由共产主义者教导宣传员和职业革命家”。

进一步的描述 somewhat 带有洛克巴尔（Rockamball(?)）式的风格。这家英国报纸发现了东方“共产主义宣传”的三个中心——符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）、塔什干和莫斯科。例如，在符拉迪沃斯托克，有一个功率强大的广播电台，使共产国际能够向日本、中国甚至荷属东印度发送报告，并“吸引年轻的马来人来到符拉迪沃斯托克学习内战的艺术”。在塔什干，《泰晤士报》的记者发现有几个机构正在“制定渗透印度和阿富汗的方法和手段”。上述充满恐惧的报纸的注意力，除其他事项外，集中在塔什干出版的《小亚细亚新闻公报》上，该刊物的“罪过”在于刊登了列宁的引文，并在创刊号中呼吁读者系统地关注东方问题。

然而，给记者留下最深印象的是莫斯科处理东方事务的方式。例如，“受邀前往莫斯科的有色人种代表，见证了红色同志们的权威和繁荣”。黑人被带领参观古老的宫殿，并被允许坐在帝国的宝座上。然后，这些被宠坏的有色土著被送往斯大林大学学习。更有能力的学员被作为 aspirants（候补研究员）吸纳进科学协会，月薪80卢布，包食宿。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The careful selection of these aspirants, in the opinion
of the correspondent, points to the fact that they are
assigned for special work of propaganda.
Moreover the "spiritual" work in Soviet Russia is carried
on in accordance with the teaching of Marx and as inspired
by the active Communism. For example the Magazine "Novi Vostok"
(The New East), a publication of the Scientific Association
for the study of the East, appears to select its data depending
on current political happenings. "The perusal of this magazine "
states the correspondent "gives one an idea of which country
has been chosen by the Komintern for the next attack". The
last issue, as an example, was widely commenting on India.
Documents seized in Shanghai in 1926 (?) pointed to the next
revolution in India in 1928(!!!) and Indians were asked to
go to Moscow to be taught how to engage in propaganda, cause
riots, and start and develop civil war".
Such is the picturization as given by the informer
(most probably a White army man) of the leading British
Imperialistic newspaper. In this description things are
so misrepresented and mixed up as to resemble a detective
story, and hardly deserve clearing up. One thing is certain
and that the above description is dictated by fear. The one
who invented those details, told lies (probably on being paid
for it), but the publisher and corrector was undoubtedly
guided by a vague, but not a mistaken instinct and understanding
that the very fact of the existence of Soviet Russia is a
serious blow to the sovereignty and domination of the imperia-
lists in the colonies - which, really, is a more serious factor
than ten thousand propagandists taken together. These latter
must be invented, because the forthcoming twilight of the
dominion of British Imperialism, is easier explained by
somebody's evil minded misdeeds. Hence, negroes, spoilt by
the sight of Romanoff's thrones, Indians studying the art
of uprisings (as though this art could be taught from school
books) and all this anti-Bolshevist nonsense, with which the
leaders of to-day's British Empire, endeavour to calm
the fears in their hearts, which arise every time they look
into the future. This nonsense is, moreover, supported by
the Conservatives in order to strengthen their stubborn and
narrow policy and to prevent any commercial agreement. Also
to check the encounter of historical forces by a self-
advantageous policy of anti-Soviet intrigues and futile
aggressive attacks.
This policy is still there. This explains the author's
reference in the above mentioned article to the signs of
aggressiveness on the part of British imperialism such as
the re-arming of the Indian Army, the development of British
aerial communication in the Minor and Near East), attempting
to disguise this reference by assertions that there is really
no need to fear any attacks and that it is more a product
of imagination founded on the spirit of militarism prevalent
in ██████ Soviet Russia. The Eastern territory of Soviet
Russia as a matter of fact in addition to connecting the
labour masses of oppressed countries with Russia, is like a gate
which we, Soviet Russians, must defend against any attempts
at intervention by the exploiters dominating in the countries
concerned. This feature is an aid to the study of the East
by Soviet Russia, which is but another means of struggle in
favour of socialism and world wide revolution and which
can only be proud by the fear-inspired reference of the
imperialistic Press.
ALAKS.

据记者认为，对这些候补研究员的精心挑选表明，他们是被指派从事特殊的宣传工作。

此外，苏维埃俄国的“精神”工作是按照马克思的学说并在积极共产主义的鼓舞下进行的。例如，东方科学研究协会出版的杂志《新东方》（Novi Vostok），似乎根据当前的政治事件来选择其资料。记者称：“阅读这本杂志让人了解到共产国际选择了哪个国家作为下一次攻击的目标。”例如，最新一期广泛评论了印度。1926年（？）在上海缴获的文件指出，下一次革命将于1928年在印度爆发（!!!），并要求印度人前往莫斯科，学习如何从事宣传、制造骚乱以及发动和发展内战”。

这就是那位告密者（很可能是一名白军分子）向这家主要的英国帝国主义报纸提供的描绘。在这种描述中，事情被歪曲和混淆得如同侦探小说一般，几乎不值得澄清。有一点是肯定的，即上述描述是由恐惧所驱使的。编造这些细节的人说了谎（可能是为了报酬），但出版者和修订者无疑受到一种模糊但并非错误的本能和理解所引导，即苏维埃俄国存在这一事实本身，就是对帝国主义者在殖民地的主权和统治的严重打击——这确实比一万名宣传员加在一起更为重要的因素。后者必须被虚构出来，因为大英帝国统治即将到来的黄昏，更容易被解释为某人心怀恶意的不法行为。因此，出现了因目睹罗曼诺夫王朝宝座而被宠坏的黑人、学习起义艺术的印度人（仿佛这门艺术可以从教科书中教授）以及所有这类反布尔什维克的 nonsense（胡言乱语），当今大英帝国的领导人试图以此平息他们每次展望未来时心中产生的恐惧。此外，保守派支持这种胡言乱语，以加强其顽固和狭隘的政策，并阻止任何商业协定。同时也为了通过利己的反苏维埃阴谋和徒劳的攻击性行动来遏制历史力量的交锋。

这项政策依然存在。这就解释了作者在上述文章中提及英国帝国主义侵略迹象的原因，如重新武装印度军队、发展英国在小亚细亚和近东的航空通讯等，并试图通过断言实际上无需担心任何攻击来掩饰这一提及，声称这更多是基于 ██████ 苏维埃俄国盛行的军国主义精神的想象产物。事实上，苏维埃俄国的东方领土除了将受压迫国家的劳动群众与俄罗斯联系起来外，就像一扇大门，我们苏维埃俄国人必须保卫它，以防相关国家中占主导地位的剥削者进行任何干预企图。这一特征有助于苏维埃俄国对东方的研究，这只是有利于社会主义和世界革命的另一种斗争手段，帝国主义报刊出于恐惧的提及只能令其感到自豪。

ALAKS.

Translation from
The "Izvestia" of March 20, 1929, Moscow.

England and China.

London, 18 March (Tass) Reuter reports: "In replying
to the question brought up at the House of Commons, Navy
Minister Bridgeman, stated that no official request had come
from the Chinese Government to send British naval officers
to serve in the Chinese Fleet. As to unofficial inquiries
on the subject, the British Government replied that so long
as the agreement is in force prohibiting the importation
of arms into China, England cannot render such assistance
as requested to China. England will, however, gladly do so
so soon as the limitations, governed by the said agreement,
are abolished."

----------

"The "unofficial inquiries" to send British naval officers
to serve in the Chinese Fleet are a new significant proof
of the relations, which are being established between Nanking
and the principal Imperialistic Powers as well as of the hopes
which the Government of Nanking has in the support of
the Powers. The reply given by Bridgeman is not significant
of the futility of these hopes, for, as the British Naval
Minister says, England is prepared to assist China in this
as soon as the agreement prohibiting importation of arms
into China is abolished. This agreement, concluded in 1919,
in reality is not observed by any of the parties concerned;
it is sufficient to point out that in British Shipyards in
Hongkong warships for the Cantonese Government are under
construction. Nevertheless it compels at times a too
open military assistance to Chinese groups of different
kind. From reports appearing recently in the Foreign Press,
United States of America (the least interested in the arms
trade in China) intend to show initiative in the matter
of abolition of the prohibition, which is unpleasant to the
Chinese Authorities. If these reports are correct one may
be certain that America will be followed by all other Powers
and thus the present Chinese Authorities will obtain direct
and open military assistance in various form from the imperialists.
The rendering of this assistance will, undoubtedly, become the
bone of contention and the object of hostility between
America and England, both of which are fighting for the
dominating influence in China.

1929年3月20日莫斯科《消息报》。

英国与中国。

伦敦，3月18日（塔斯社）路透社报道：“在回答下议院提出的问题时，海军大臣布里奇曼表示，中国政府并未正式请求派遣英国海军军官在中国舰队服役。至于关于此事的非正式询问，英国政府答复称，只要禁止向中国进口武器的协议仍然有效，英国就不能应要求向中国提供此类援助。然而，一旦上述协议规定的限制被废除，英国将乐意提供援助。”

----------

“派遣英国海军军官在中国舰队服役”的“非正式询问”，是南京与主要帝国主义列强之间正在建立的关系的新的重要证明，也是南京政府对列强支持所抱希望的证明。布里奇曼的答复并不意味着这些希望是徒劳的，因为正如英国海军大臣所说，一旦禁止向中国进口武器的协议被废除，英国就准备在这方面援助中国。这项于1919年达成的协议，实际上并未被任何一方遵守；只需指出一点，在香港的英国造船厂正在为广东政府建造军舰。尽管如此，它有时仍迫使各方避免对中国各派系提供过于公开的军事援助。根据最近外国报刊的报道，美国（对中国军火贸易兴趣最小）打算在废除这一令中国当局不快的禁令方面表现出主动性。如果这些报道属实，可以肯定美国将得到其他所有列强的追随，从而现任中国当局将从帝国主义者那里获得各种形式的直接和公开的军事援助。提供这种援助无疑将成为美英之间争论的焦点和敌视的对象，两国都在为在中国的主导影响力而斗争。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of November 23, 1928.

The Pan Pacific Congress of Labour Unions
in Vladivostock.

Moscow, 23 (Tass). In connection with the Pan-Pacific
Congress of Labour Unions convened in Vladivostock for
August 1, 1929, the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour Unions
issued an appeal to all professional organisations of the
Pan-Pacific countries.
It is said in the appeal that the efforts of imperialism
to strangle the labour class and prevent the freedom
movement are closely connected with imperialistic internal
antagonism and will inevitably bring about a war in the
Pacific. The Congress will enable the Pan-Pacific Labour
Unions to have joint discussions as to a future programme
of action prior to the breaking out of the war.
International unity of the labour movement to resist
the attacks of capitalism and imperialism is one of the
main and immediate tasks of the labour class. In the Pacific
the necessity of this unity is the more emphasized now
owing to attempts of Japanese Imperialism to organize a
counter institution to the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions in the form of "An Asiatic Labour Confederation",
which will be approved by the Japanese Imperialism. It is
necessary to disclose the working of that organization
meant to cause a split.
The appeal furthermore advocates that the programme
of activities at the forthcoming Congress should be drafted
in consideration of demands and needs of the present time
and distributed in all countries on the Pacific Coast.
The Secretariat suggests the following agenda for
the Congress:- Report of the Secretariat. Military Danger
and struggle with Imperialism. Movement of Freedom in
the colonies and the part of labour unions and christian
organizations. International unity of labour movement,
immigration and emigration in the Pacific Coast countries.
Programme of activities :- Seven hours' labour day,
maximum pay for labour, women's and children's labour,
unemployment, social legislation, direct problems in China,
Japan, India, Indonesia, Korea, Philippines, etc.
The Secretariat requests all organizations sending
delegates to the Congress to formulate their suggestions
for the agenda as well as their opinions on all matters
so as to make it easier to inform all other organizations
connected with it.

Copies forwarded to:-
H.B.M. Consul
Lieut. Coll G.H.R. Halland, J.B.E., N. China Command.
Capt, J.P. Shelley , North China Command.
Lieut. E.F. Carlson, U.S. Marine Corps.
Sent 8 ~ 18'

译自1928年11月23日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

在符拉迪沃斯托克召开的泛太平洋工会代表大会。

莫斯科，23日（塔斯社电）。鉴于定于1929年8月1日在符拉迪沃斯托克召开泛太平洋工会代表大会，泛太平洋工会书记处向泛太平洋各国的所有职业组织发出呼吁书。
呼吁书称，帝国主义扼杀工人阶级并阻碍自由运动的努力，与帝国主义内部的对抗密切相关，并将不可避免地导致太平洋战争。此次大会将使泛太平洋各工会能够在战争爆发前，就未来的行动纲领进行共同讨论。
工人运动在国际上团结一致，以抵抗资本主义和帝国主义的攻击，是工人阶级主要且紧迫的任务之一。在太平洋地区，由于日本帝国主义试图建立一个与泛太平洋工会书记处相对抗的机构，即“亚洲劳工联合会”，该机构将得到日本帝国主义的认可，因此这种团结的必要性现在更加突出。有必要揭露那个旨在造成分裂的组织的运作。
此外，呼吁书主张，即将召开的大会的活动纲领应根据当前的需求和需要来起草，并在太平洋沿岸所有国家分发。
书记处建议大会采用以下议程：- 书记处报告。军事危险与反帝斗争。殖民地的自由运动以及工会和基督教组织在其中的作用。工人运动的国际团结，太平洋沿岸国家的移民和出境问题。
活动纲领：- 七小时工作日，最高工资，妇女和儿童劳动，失业问题，社会立法，中国、日本、印度、印度尼西亚、朝鲜、菲律宾等地的直接问题。
书记处请所有派遣代表参加大会的组织提出对议程的建议以及对所有事项的意见，以便更容易地通知所有与之相关的其他组织。

副本分送：-
英国驻华领事
G.H.R. Halland 中校，J.B.E.，华北司令部。
J.P. Shelley 上尉，华北司令部。
E.F. Carlson 中尉，美国海军陆战队。
发送于 8 ~ 18'

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) Nov. 7, 1928.

Anniversary of Russian Revolution.

In connection with the eleventh anniversary of Soviet
Revolution many greetings on the occasion were received
by the Russian proletariat from other countries. One of
these was a telegram from Swedish seamen of the s.s. "Benares"
and the other from the Union of Red German soldiers.

A word about "coolies" and "boys", etc.

There is a vast difference between then and now in the
treatment of yellow servants. Those who lived in the Russian
Far East before will understand what is meant.
For example to-day we see in Shanghai on Nanking Road
how a hired native policeman hits on the head a Chinese
coolie who happens to get mixed up in the traffic. Instructions
from the Police Station by telephone are to remove the body
and that's all. There are very few horses in Shanghai, but
these are replaced by human "ponies" - the rickshaws. One can
experience a feeling of "imperialism" when riding in those.
A Yellow, dirty and sweating, pulls the carriage in which
a White is sitting in comfort and woe if the former makes
a wrong turn or something like that, at once the well dressed
foot of the latter hits him in the back regardless of his
tiredness. This is very amusing to some people and often
wives of British merchants are heard to relate such instances
with a smile when travelling outside Asia.
In China, in Shanghai, his own country, a Chinese has
no right to walk on every street, but in his home - the U.S.S.R.
a Chinese or a Korean is a citizen equal to others.

We have thousands and hundreds of thousands Koreans
and Chinese organized in labour unions and participating in
public, economic, and state work of the country. Often
both Chinese and Koreans hold responsible posts in different
official administrations and concerns.

Translation from the Krasnoe Znamya of November 10, 1928.

A message from prisoners in Mukden.

Dear friends in the Primorie,
On the day of the IIth anniversary of October we send you
our warm comradely greetings and sincere thanks for the
steady and persistent maintenance and support of Soviet power
in the Far East. News penetrating only too scarce behind the
prison walls give us joy and help us to bear hardships patiently
in the assurance that the cause of the labourers is in
reliable hands and on the right track. Once again friendly
greetings and wishes of all success.
Prisoners of the Mukden Gaol.

Accidents in American Aviation.

In the first six months of 1928 there were 390 accidents
with 153 casualties and 276 people wounded. These apply mostly
to amateur aviation. In the regular service there were only 34
accidents with six deaths. However it is a high percentage
generally considering that in Soviet Russia during the same
period of time there were no accidents at all. The pilots are
in a great measure responsible for the accidents, then comes
the fault of the motors not being in good state of repairs and
lastly bad meteorological conditions.

译自1928年11月7日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

俄国革命周年纪念。

值此苏维埃革命十一周年之际，俄国无产阶级收到了来自其他国家的许多贺电。其中一份是来自“贝纳雷斯”号（s.s. "Benares"）轮船上的瑞典海员，另一份来自德国红色士兵联盟。

关于“苦力”和“侍童”等的一点看法。

如今与过去相比，对待黄色仆役的方式有着巨大的差异。以前居住在俄罗斯远东地区的人都会明白这是什么意思。
例如，今天我们在上海南京路上看到，一名受雇的本地巡捕用头撞击一名恰好卷入交通纠纷的中国苦力。警察局通过电话下达指令，要求移走尸体，仅此而已。上海的马匹很少，但取而代之的是人力“小马”——即黄包车。乘坐这些车时，人们可以体验到一种“帝国主义”的感觉。一个肮脏、流着汗的黄色人种，拉着坐着一位舒适白人的车子，如果前者转错了弯或发生类似情况，后者穿着考究的脚会立刻踢向前者的背部，全然不顾其疲惫。这对某些人来说非常有趣，经常听到英国商人的妻子在离开亚洲旅行时，微笑着讲述此类事例。
在中国，在上海，在他自己的国家，中国人无权走在每一条街道上，但在他的家园——苏联，中国人或朝鲜人是与他人平等的公民。

我们有成千上万乃至数十万的朝鲜人和中国人组织在工会中，并参与该国的公共、经济和国家工作。中国人和朝鲜人经常在不同的官方行政机构和企事业单位中担任重要职务。

译自1928年11月10日《红旗报》。

来自沈阳囚犯的信息。

滨海地区的亲爱的朋友们，
在十月革命十一周年纪念日，我们向你们致以热烈的同志般的问候，并衷心感谢你们对远东苏维埃政权的坚定和持续维护与支持。透过监狱高墙渗透进来的消息虽然寥寥无几，却给我们带来了喜悦，并帮助我们要耐心地忍受苦难，因为我们确信劳动者的事业掌握在可靠的人手中，并且走在正确的道路上。再次致以友好的问候和祝一切顺利。
沈阳监狱囚犯。

美国航空事故。

1928年上半年，共发生390起事故，造成153人死亡，276人受伤。这些事故主要涉及业余航空。在定期航班服务中，仅发生34起事故，造成6人死亡。然而，总体而言，这是一个很高的百分比，考虑到在同一时期，苏维埃俄罗斯根本没有发生任何事故。飞行员对事故负有很大责任，其次是发动机维修状况不佳，最后是恶劣的气象条件。

"Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of May 5 writes as follows:-
To Labourers, Peasants and Red Army
（印：... 9.199 ... 29.5.29 ...）

The Committee of Red Army Men of Germany send their fraternal greetings to you on behalf of the army men and labourers of Germany and particularly Berlin, assuring you of their fidelity to Proletarian Revolution and a promise to fight for U.S.S.R.

May Day of 1929 is of more significance than ever to the international proletariat. German proletariat has decided on that day to rise up against the bourgeoisie and social-democrats as well as to oppose imperialistic war threat against U.S.S.R. When the labourers of Germany are ready to demonstrate and demand improvements for the labour class, the Chief of Berlin Police, is preparing to have bloodshed on the streets of Berlin on May 1. He has declared that he will turn the streets of the Capital of Germany into a military camp and will fire upon the demonstrators if they dare parade the streets. Still the members of the Union of Red Army Men and Berlin proletarians will demonstrate on May 1. They will show thereby their readiness to fight their class enemies in the countries and in defence of U.S.S.R. The following mottoes will be pronounced in Germany by the proletarians on May 1:-
Against the imperialistic war!
Down with Fascism and Reformism!
For the Defence of U.S.S.R.!
For the victory of proletarian revolution!
Under the banners of Lenin the German Labour Class will march in honour of the victorious German October.
Willy Leow.

In Defence of U.S.S.R. and for the Downfall of Capitalism!

Comrades,
In a few days we shall celebrate Labour Day when millions of young and older labourers will demonstrate their desire to fight. 40 years have elapsed since the institution of the IInd International when the first appeal was made to the proletarians of the whole world to prove themselves ready for the overthrow of capitalistic form of governments by holding powerful demonstrations on May 1. This has been done year after year. The labour party members in large numbers could never have thought that the social-democrats will one day refuse to support the mottoes they at first promoted. Proletarian demands to-day meet with opposition from the treacherous social democrats. The world war has taught the international proletariat a good lesson. There is another imperialistic war against U.S.S.R. threatening May 1. When to-day we see the social democratic minister of Germany named Grzesinsky and the Police Chief of Berlin, another social-democrat named Zergibel imprison hundreds of best revolutionaries and forbidding the May 1 demonstrations, this is proof of their treachery.
The Union of Communist Youth must mobilize all young labourers to oppose the forthcoming and impending war against U.S.S.R. in the defence of proletarian dictatorship all over the world and the downfall of capitalistic form of government. With these wishes the Union send you comradely greetings.
The Central Union of Communistic Youth of Germany.
Berlin April 19, 1929.

5月5日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）写道：-
致工人、农民和红军
（印：... 9.199 ... 29.5.29 ...）

德国红军战士委员会代表德国特别是柏林的军人和劳动者，向你们致以兄弟般的问候，并向你们保证他们对无产阶级革命的忠诚以及为苏联而战的承诺。

1929年的五一节对国际无产阶级具有比以往更重大的意义。德国无产阶级决定在这一天起来反对资产阶级和社会民主党人，并反对针对苏联的帝国主义战争威胁。当德国劳动者准备示威并要求改善工人阶级待遇时，柏林警察局长却准备在5月1日让柏林街头血流成河。他宣称要将德国首都的街道变成军营，如果示威者敢上街游行，他就向他们开火。尽管如此，红军战士联盟成员和柏林无产者仍将在5月1日举行示威。他们将以此表明他们准备在国内打击阶级敌人并保卫苏联。5月1日，德国无产者将喊出以下口号：-
反对帝国主义战争！
打倒法西斯主义和改良主义！
保卫苏联！
争取无产阶级革命的胜利！
在列宁的旗帜下，德国工人阶级将为纪念胜利的德国十月革命而进军。
威利·莱奥（Willy Leow）。

保卫苏联，推翻资本主义！

同志们，
几天后我们将庆祝劳动节，届时数百万年轻和年长的劳动者将展示他们的战斗意愿。自第二国际成立并首次呼吁全世界无产者在5月1日举行大规模示威以证明他们准备好推翻资本主义政府形式以来，已经过去了40年。这一行动年复一年地得以实施。工党成员大量加入时，从未想到社会民主党人有朝一日会拒绝支持他们最初提倡的口号。今天，无产阶级的要求遭到了背信弃义的社会民主党人的反对。世界大战给国际无产阶级上了深刻的一课。另一次针对苏联的帝国主义战争正威胁着五一节。当我们今天看到德国的社会民主党部长格热辛斯基（Grzesinsky）和柏林警察局长、另一位名为泽吉贝尔（Zergibel）的社会民主党人监禁数百名最优秀的革命者并禁止五一示威时，这就是他们背叛行为的证明。
共产主义青年团联盟必须动员所有年轻劳动者，反对即将爆发和迫在眉睫的对苏战争，以保卫全世界的无产阶级专政并推翻资本主义政府形式。怀着这些愿望，联盟向你们致以同志般的问候。
德国共产主义青年团中央联盟。
1929年4月19日，柏林。

"Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of April 23, 1929.

The International Club at Vladivostock.

A Swedish sailor from the s.s. "Dehli" writes:
"Comrades, I have been for the first time in Russia and will attempt to relate our impressions. Regretfully our stay here was very short, but nevertheless we have good impression of Soviet country. In most countries a clergyman calls on board and takes us away with him, whereas here we were invited to a club. Every evening after the work was over we were asked to the Club and then to theatre or cinema or else we stayed there and held interesting discussions. We were very pleased every time with our restful hours."
The International Club in Vladivostock is the only one of its kind along the Pacific Coast and seamen visiting Vladivostock know of it. In spite of the Club not being too comfortably arranged, the number of foreign visitors to it is increasing. Various excursions are arranged for these visitors.
It has been, however, difficult to make the Club popular amongst members of labour unions. International education is rather neglected. The 3rd Conference of labour unions emphasized the necessity of enlisting greater attention to this branch of activity. Attempts are now being made to bring foreign seamen together with professional workers.
Vladivostock is about to have the 2nd Pan Pacific Congress of Labour Unions. The labour population must be well informed of the programme of the Conference. This will be a big step towards international education. The International Club and foreign seamen must take part in the Conference.

Trade.

The Soviet Syndicate of Matches has despatched to China via the Port of Vladivostock 720 thousand boxes of matches.

（印：POLITICAL BRANCH / FOREIGN OFFICE / 29.5.29）

1929年4月23日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）的国际俱乐部。

“德里”号（s.s. "Dehli"）轮船的一名瑞典水手写道：
“同志们，这是我第一次来到俄国，我将尝试讲述我们的印象。遗憾的是，我们在这里停留的时间非常短，但尽管如此，我们对苏维埃国家留下了良好的印象。在大多数国家，牧师会上船并将我们带走，而在这里，我们被邀请去俱乐部。每天工作结束后，我们都被邀请到俱乐部，然后去剧院或电影院，或者我们就留在那里进行有趣的讨论。每次我们对休息时光都感到非常满意。”
符拉迪沃斯托克的国际俱乐部是太平洋沿岸唯一此类俱乐部，访问符拉迪沃斯托克的海员都知道它。尽管俱乐部的设施安排得不太舒适，但前往该俱乐部的外国访客人数正在增加。为这些访客安排了各种游览活动。
然而，要使俱乐部在工会成员中流行起来却很困难。国际教育相当被忽视。工会第三次会议强调有必要更加关注这一活动领域。目前正试图将外国海员与专业工人聚集在一起。
符拉迪沃斯托克即将举行第二届泛太平洋工会大会。必须让劳动人口充分了解大会的议程。这将是迈向国际教育的一大步。国际俱乐部和外国海员必须参加大会。

贸易。

苏联火柴辛迪加已通过符拉迪沃斯托克港向中国发送了72万盒火柴。

（印：政治处 / 外务科 / 29.5.29）

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of May 30th
Problems of the Pan Pacific Congress of
Labour Unions. (Interview with Comr. Lozovsky).

During the two years dating from the inauguration of
the organization of the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions, great events have taken place on the Pacific Coast.
The defeat of the Chinese labour movement has dealt a
considerable blow to the Pan Pacific Secretariat, reaction
having rendered the Secretariat unlawful at the time and
prevented it from fully carrying out problems set for it
by the Conference at Hankow.
Nevertheless the Pan Pacific Secretariat had greatly
assisted the Chinese labour movement, opposing foreign
influences and uniting the conscious elements of Chinese
labour movement.
In Japan, in spite of the reign of terror, the revolution-
ary wing of the Japanese labour movement never ceased to
have connection with the Secretariat. The latter on the
other hand rendered every assistance in its power to the
"left" wing of the labour movement, in the latter's hard
struggle against reformers and capitalists.
During the two years of its existence the Pan Pacific
Secretariat included in the international labour movement
the proletariat of the Philippine Islands and the vanguard
elements of the labour movement in Australia, having also
established connections with the labour movement of Formosa,
Singapore, Pan Pacific countries and Latin America.
Up to the present owing to the severe police vigilance
and terrorism labour unions of Indonesia are not too well
connected with the Pan Pacific Secretariat, although they
were in the first ranks of initiators for the unification
of labourers on the Pacific Coast. Furthermore connection
is also weak with the labour unions of India, but this will
be improved and then the united front of the labourers
of Pacific Coast will be secured.
The Pan Pacific Secretariat has had to work all this
time under very hard conditions. In order to sum up
the activities of two years the Conference of the Pacific
Labour Unions is being convened at Vladivostock. An attempt
to convene this Conference in Australia failed. The
Australian Government strongly objected to the Conference
being held in its territory.
The programme of the Pan Pacific Conference includes
the problem of opposition to war and imperialism, the
question of national freedom movement, emigration questions,
problems affecting women's and children's labour,
organizational and constitutional questions of education
and enlightenment and programme of activities. Taking into
consideration the racial, national and cultural variety
which the Pacific Coast represents, it is not surprising
that the programme of the Conference is extensive.
The Conference will have to solve three main problems:
opposition to war, opposition to racial distinction and
the instigation of one race against another and opposition
to prohibition of extremist labour unions, which should be
legalized. Already at the Conference in Hankow in 1927
a programme of activities had been drawn up with the
following slogan as a guide:- "equal pay for equal labour
irrespective of the colour of skin and of the sex".
The Conference will have to deal with the above question.
The difference between conditions of life of the labourers
on the Pacific Coast is too great. Australian labourers
get paid for labour 15 to 20 times as much as the Chinese
labourers. In view of the extent of industry in the
East in its development, such a state of things threatens
the level of the labourers of capitalistic countries.

（批：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. 9199...
Date... 28. 6. 29.）

5月30日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）
泛太平洋工会大会的问题。（采访洛佐夫斯基同志）。

在泛太平洋工会秘书处组织成立以来的两年间，太平洋沿岸发生了重大事件。中国工人运动的失败对泛太平洋秘书处造成了相当大的打击，反动势力当时使秘书处成为非法组织，并阻碍其充分执行汉口会议为其设定的任务。
尽管如此，泛太平洋秘书处极大地援助了中国工人运动，反对外国影响并团结中国工人运动中的觉悟分子。
在日本，尽管处于恐怖统治之下，日本工人运动的革命派从未停止与秘书处的联系。另一方面，后者在其权力范围内向工人运动的“左”翼提供了一切援助，支持其在反对改良主义者和资本家的艰苦斗争中。
在存在的两年期间，泛太平洋秘书处将菲律宾群岛的无产阶级和澳大利亚工人运动的先锋分子纳入国际工人运动，并与台湾、新加坡、泛太平洋国家和拉丁美洲的工人运动建立了联系。
截至目前，由于严厉的警察监视和恐怖主义，印度尼西亚的工会与泛太平洋秘书处的联系并不紧密，尽管它们曾是发起太平洋沿岸劳动者统一的第一批先驱。此外，与印度工会的联系也很薄弱，但这将会得到改善，随后太平洋沿岸劳动者的统一战线将获得保障。
泛太平洋秘书处一直不得不在非常艰难的条件下工作。为了总结两年的活动，太平洋工会会议正在符拉迪沃斯托克召开。此前试图在澳大利亚召开此次会议未能成功。澳大利亚政府强烈反对在其领土上举行会议。
泛太平洋会议的议程包括反对战争和帝国主义的问题、民族自由运动问题、移民问题、涉及妇女和儿童劳工的问题、教育和启蒙的组织及章程问题以及活动计划。考虑到太平洋沿岸所代表的种族、民族和文化多样性，会议议程广泛并不令人惊讶。
会议必须解决三个主要问题：反对战争、反对种族歧视以及反对煽动一个种族对抗另一个种族，并反对禁止极端主义工会，这些工会应当合法化。早在1927年的汉口会议上，就已制定了一项活动计划，并以以下口号为指导：“同工同酬，不分肤色和性别”。
会议将处理上述问题。太平洋沿岸劳动者的生活条件差异太大。澳大利亚劳动者的工资是中国劳动者的15到20倍。鉴于东方工业发展的程度，这种状况威胁到资本主义国家劳动者的生活水平。

（批：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事情报科登记室
编号 9199...
日期... 29.6.28.）

The Pan Pacific Conference of labour Unions will
collect representatives of colonial, semi-colonial, all
capitalistic countries, which have Colonies on the Pacific
Coast and also those of the Soviet Union of Countries.
In this manner fraternization between representatives
of the victorious proletariat and labourers of the
capitalistic colonial and semi-colonial countries will
again take place.
THE FORTHCOMING PAN PACIFIC CONFERENCE OF LABOUR
UNIONS IS ALSO OF THE GREATEST SIGNIFICANCE FOR THE
UNIFICATION OF ALL FORCES OF THE WORLD PROLETARIAT
IN ITS OPPOSITION TO IMPERIALISM.
The origin of the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Unions
testifies that in a number of new countries labour organiza-
tions have been established and formed.
In concluding the interview, Comrade Losowsky
said:- "We will form a united front and will establish
fraternal connection between the Labour International,
the Pan Pacific Secretariat and the Latin-American
Confederation of labour unions and by joint efforts
will fight imperialism, fascism and their reformatory
hirelings.

The "Izvestia" of May 28th writes as follows:-

Scandalous process in Shanghai.
The organizer of an attack on the
Soviet Consulate is a black-mailer.

Shanghai, May 26 (Tass). The secret informer
of the British Intelligence Service and the principal
organizer of the attack on Soviet Consulate in 1927,
named Pick, who had published in the British reactionary
publication "The North China Daily News" a series of
provocative articles against U.S.S.R., has been arrested
by the Police of the International Settlement on a charge
of defrauding Chinese. At the preliminary examination
in Court Pick stated that the authorities who assisted
him in the fraud, had offered him a large sum of money
to keep quiet about the matter.
The arrest of Pick caused a tremendous sensation in
the Settlement. His case will be tried in a few days.
--------
We cannot overlook the concluding episode of Shanghai
adventures of Mr. Pick, because this offender in small
affairs, thanks to the British Intelligence Service, but
recently was entitled to mention in the world's history.
Captain Eugene Pick began to be known in Shanghai in
1927 when in the local British Press began to appear
his anti-sensational "revelations" of various Bolshevik
plots in China. These appearances of Pick in the Press,
who posed as one in principle opposed to Bolshevism and
Semitism, later on served as "documents" in which the
entire imperialistic and particularly British Press of
the Far East and partly in Europe found support in their
wild anti-Soviet campaign. If we are not mistaken his
statements were repeated on several occasions in the
British Parliament itself. Having thus rendered a good
service to the British donkeys (?) Pick was accepted
in the field of British Intelligence Service in Shanghai.

泛太平洋工会大会将汇集殖民地、半殖民地、所有在太平洋沿岸拥有殖民地的资本主义国家以及苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟的代表。
以这种方式，胜利的无产阶级代表与资本主义殖民地和半殖民地国家的劳动者之间的联谊将再次发生。
即将到来的泛太平洋工会大会对于统一世界无产阶级反对帝国主义的所有力量也具有最重大的意义。
工会泛太平洋秘书处的起源证明，在一些新兴国家，劳工组织已经建立并形成。
在结束采访时，洛佐夫斯基（Losowsky）同志说：“我们将组成统一战线，并在劳工国际、泛太平洋秘书处和拉丁美洲工会联合会之间建立兄弟般的联系，并通过共同努力打击帝国主义、法西斯主义及其改良主义走狗。

5月28日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：-

上海的丑闻案件。
袭击苏联领事馆的组织者是一名敲诈勒索者。

上海，5月26日（塔斯社）。英国情报局的秘密线人、1927年袭击苏联领事馆的主要组织者，名为皮克（Pick），曾在英国反动刊物《字林西报》（The North China Daily News）上发表了一系列针对苏联的挑衅性文章，现因诈骗中国人被公共租界警方逮捕。在法庭初步审讯中，皮克称，协助他进行诈骗的当局曾向他提供一大笔钱，让他对此事保持沉默。
皮克的被捕在租界引起了巨大轰动。他的案件将在几天后审理。
--------
我们不能忽视皮克先生在上海冒险经历的结尾插曲，因为这名在小事中犯罪的 offender，得益于英国情报局，最近竟有资格在世界历史上被提及。
尤金·皮克（Eugene Pick）上尉于1927年开始在上海为人所知，当时当地英国报刊开始刊登他关于中国各种布尔什维克阴谋的反耸人听闻的“揭露”。皮克在报刊上的这些露面，使他摆出一副原则上反对布尔什维克主义和闪米特主义（Semitism）的姿态，后来成为了“文件”，整个帝国主义、特别是远东和部分欧洲的英国报刊在其疯狂的anti-Soviet运动中从中找到了支持。如果我们没有记错的话，他的陈述甚至在英国议会本身也被重复了几次。通过这样为英国 donkeys (?) 提供了良好的服务，皮克被接纳进入英国驻上海情报局领域。

Amongst his heroic actions in this field it is
sufficient to mention that he personally led the crowd
of Whites to the Soviet Consulate for an attack, which
had been planned to seize the Consulate and exterminate
its officials and employees. Later on the business of
Pick had evidently not proved so successful and he was
thus compelled, in addition to his portion of British
sandwiches, revert to his former methods of seeking
the bread of life. As a result a criminal case, arrest
and a tremendous scandal because of it. The case of
Pick once more raises the curtain of the dirty methods
and vile weapons used by the antiSoviet policy of British
Imperialism.

The "Izvestia" of May 25, 1929 writes as follows:-
August First - International Opposition Day
to Imperialistic War.

Berlin, May 23 (Tass) The Western European Bureau
of the Komintern published information about the Conference
held by Communistic Parties in Brussels with a view to
discussing preparations for an international anti-military
day. On May 16 the Conference was held in Brussels in
which 13 most prominent Communistic parties took part
all of which belong to the capitalistic countries of Europe,
there were also representatives of unlawful Parties and
those of Kim and Profintern. At the opening of the
Conference a representative of the Central Communistic Party
of Germany gave information on the May Day disturbances in
Berlin.
The principal matter discussed was however the
plan of preparations for the international anti-military
day, which was previously decided upon by the VIth
Congress of the Komintern. A conference held in March in
Berlin suggested that the anti military day be assigned
for August I, 1929, it being attended by representatives
of 14 European communistic Parties.
It is necessary for the purpose of carrying out the
plans of the anti-military day successfully that unconditional
consent be obtained from the various members of the
Communistic Parties to refrain from all influence of the
"right" and conciliating tendencies and to combat passiveness.
New practical suggestions for the promotion of the
campaign were made to the Communistic Parties in brief
form. It was considered necessary to unite and maintain
in unity the wide masses of labourers employed in different
concerns and members of various proletariat organizations
both during the preparations for and the actual process
of the anti-military day. The Anti-military day is to
be marked chiefly by cessation to work and mass demonstrations
on that day.
For the consecutive development and increase of the
campaign in favour of the anti-military day, all questions
pertaining to it must be systematically made clear and
particularly by showing the people what plans are being
made against U.S.S.R. in the form of a war. This matter
should be stressed upon in the Communistic Press and also
dealt with during the Government sessions as a thing to
be strongly objected to. Publications should be distributed
in working concerns containing matter against war and
advocating revolutionary opposition to it. Literature
should also be widely distributed against imperialistic
policy and armaments.
Upon the conclusion of discussion on the above matters,
the Conference heard some information on the subject of
the situation in India and the revolutionary spirit of
a labour uprising in India; it was also decided to send
comradely greetings to the textile workers on strike in
Bombay.
In conclusion the Conference passed a resolution that
an appeal be made to all labourers and members of the mass
revolutionary organizations to participate in the preparations
of and the carrying out of August I programme.

1929年5月25日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：——
八月一日——国际反对帝国主义战争日。

柏林，5月23日（塔斯社）共产国际西欧局发布了关于在布鲁塞尔举行的共产党会议的信息，旨在讨论筹备国际反战日事宜。5月16日，会议在布鲁塞尔举行，13个最著名的共产党派代表参加，这些党派均属于欧洲资本主义国家，此外还有非法政党的代表以及青年共产国际和红色工会国际的代表。在德国共产党中央委员会代表开幕发言时，通报了柏林五一节骚乱的情况。
然而，讨论的主要事项是筹备国际反战日的计划，该计划此前已由共产国际第六次代表大会决定。3月在柏林举行的一次会议建议将反战日定在1929年8月1日，当时有14个欧洲共产党的代表出席。
为了成功执行反战日的计划，必须获得各共产党成员的无条件同意，以抵制所有“右”倾和调和倾向的影响，并克服消极被动。会议以简要形式向各共产党提出了促进运动的新实际建议。认为有必要在反战日的筹备期间及实际进行过程中，团结并保持受雇于不同企业的广大劳工群众及各无产阶级组织成员的统一。反战日的主要标志是在当天停工和举行大规模示威游行。
为了连续发展和加强支持反战日的运动，必须系统地澄清与此有关的所有问题，特别是向民众展示针对苏联的战争计划。此事应在共产主义报刊上加以强调，并在政府会议期间作为强烈反对的事项进行处理。应向工作场所分发包含反战内容和倡导革命性反对战争的出版物。还应广泛分发反对帝国主义政策和军备的文献。
在上述事项讨论结束后，会议听取了一些关于印度局势和印度劳工起义的革命精神的信息；还决定向孟买罢工的纺织工人致以同志般的问候。
最后，会议通过了一项决议，呼吁所有劳工和群众革命组织的成员参与八月一日计划的筹备和执行工作。

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.
29 Session.

Revolutionary movement in the colonies.

At the morning sitting of August 21 which was presided over
by Comrade Remmele (Germany) closing speeches were delivered by Co.
Sicander(India), Strakhoff(China), and Pepper and Kuusinen.
At the evening sitting Congress approved of the thesis with regard
to the colonial question and appointed a committee to final draft it.
Comrade Sicander asserted that British imperialism in India strives
chiefly to secure the monopoly of the situation and use India as a
source for obtaining industrial raw material and agricultural products
on the one hand, and as a market for British industrial products -
on the other. Comrade Sicander stated that these themes, coupled with
military ones, render the construction of railway net-work in India
inevitable. The investment of capital by Britain in India is for
this purpose and not for the developing of heavy industry and the
industrialisation of India into an independent economic unit.
Comrade Sicander then touched on the question of India's national
bourgeoisie. We, he said, are not being xxif deceived with regard to
the Indian bourgeoisie. It is, without doubt, counter-revolutionary,
betrays the revolution and compromises by agreements with imperialism.
Those, who believe that the Indian bourgeoisies have not yet betrayed
the Indian revolution in the same manner as the Kuomintang did with
the Chinese one, are mistaken. During the period of political crisis, or
war, the higher classes of the Indian bourgeoisie will march hand in
hand with British imperialism. The lower xxxxxx bourgeois classes will
struggle for the political power and will endeavour to use labourers
and peasants in this struggle as gunfodder. We should unmask the petty
bourgeoisie which possess influence among the masses.
Comrade Strakhoff in the name of the Chinese delegation made the
following declaration. The assertion made by Pepper previously that
Sun-Senism reigned in the Chinese party, but that now Trotzkiism succeeds
is incorrect. During the Canton insurrection Comrade Pepper advanced
the slogan: "Village self-administration". Just at that time the pea-
sants were engaged in the insurrection. Thus comrade Pepper went
one step farther than did Trotzky who asserted that the Chinese re-
volution was on the decline. Comrade Pepper in the Programme Committee
defended the point of view that in China one does not speak now of
feudalism but of "Asiatic methods of production", which abstractly denies
the slogan of "nationalisation of the land". It is easily understood
therefore why comrade Pepper opposed the anti-imperialistic movement
to agrarian revolution, although in reality xxx to overthrow imperialism
is impossible without an agrarian revolution.
The industrialisation of colonies is impossible because the
imperialists support the most backward system of land ownership. The
nationalist bourgeoisie are strongly interwoven with semi-feudalism,
the gentry and land-owners. Certainly the bourgeoisie are opposed to
militarism so long as it does not undermine the foundation upon which
the exploitation of the toiling people rests. However, when this question

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第29次会议。

殖民地的革命运动。

在8月21日上午的会议上，由雷梅勒同志（德国）主持，西坎德尔同志（印度）、斯特拉霍夫（Strakhoff，中国）以及佩珀（Pepper）和库西宁（Kuusinen）作了总结发言。
在晚上的会议上，大会批准了关于殖民地问题的提纲，并任命了一个委员会来完成最终草案。
西坎德尔同志断言，英国在印度的帝国主义主要致力于确保其垄断地位，一方面将印度作为获取工业原材料和农产品的来源，另一方面作为英国工业产品的市场。西坎德尔同志指出，这些主题加上军事主题，使得在印度建设铁路网成为必然。英国在印度的资本投资正是出于此目的，而非为了发展重工业或将印度工业化成为一个独立的经济单位。
随后，西坎德尔同志谈到了印度民族资产阶级的问题。他说，我们在印度资产阶级问题上并没有被xxif（原文不清）欺骗。毫无疑问，它是反革命的，背叛革命并通过与帝国主义达成协议来进行妥协。那些认为印度资产阶级尚未像国民党背叛中国革命那样背叛印度革命的人，是错误的。在政治危机或战争时期，印度资产阶级的上层阶级将与英国帝国主义携手并进。下层xxxxxx资产阶级阶级将为争夺政治权力而斗争，并企图在这场斗争中将劳工和农民当作炮灰。我们应该揭露在群众中具有影响力的小资产阶级。
斯特拉霍夫同志代表中国代表团发表如下声明。佩珀此前声称孙文主义曾在中国党内占统治地位，但现在托洛茨基主义取而代之，这种说法是不正确的。在广州起义期间，佩珀同志提出了“乡村自治”的口号。就在那时，农民正投身于起义。因此，佩珀同志比托洛茨基走得更远，后者声称中国革命正在衰退。佩珀同志在纲领委员会中捍卫了这样一种观点，即在中国现在谈论的不是封建主义，而是“亚细亚生产方式”，这在抽象层面上否定了“土地国有化”的口号。因此，很容易理解为什么佩珀同志将反帝国主义运动与土地革命对立起来，尽管实际上xxx（原文不清）没有土地革命就不可能推翻帝国主义。
殖民地的工业化是不可能的，因为帝国主义者支持最落后的土地所有制体系。民族资产阶级与半封建势力、士绅和地主紧密交织在一起。当然，只要军国主义不破坏剥削劳动人民的基础，资产阶级就反对军国主义。然而，当这个问题

is put to the test there will be either the dictatorship of bourgeois and
land-owners, or the dictatorship of the proletariat and peasants. We must
support the national liberation movement. But, at the samexxxxxxx time, we
must strongly oppose national-fascism and national-reformism. We should
win over the petty bourgeoisie to our side always taking care that our
party should not fall under the influence of the petty bourgeoisie.
Comrade Pepper stated that the problem polemics on the subject of the
the Canton insurrection had not been started by him, but by comrade Lomi-
nadze. The resolution, adopted by the IX Plenum of the Executive Committee
of the Communist International, paid due tribute, on the one hand, to the
heroic insurrection of the Canton proletariat, and on the other - criti-
cised the blunders committed by those persons who prepared and directed
the riot. It was impossible to identify, as Comrades Strakhoff and Lominad-
dze had done, the heroic struggle of the Chinese proletariat with the
mistakes committed by the leading circles of the Chinese Communist party.
We should expose all mistakes committed at the Canton riot in order to
enable us in future not only to organize insurrection, but also victorious
insurrections.
Comrade Kuusinen(Finland) who succeeded Pepper stated, after criti-
cising the opinions of some of the previous speakers: We have achieved
a very notable success at this congress. It is the first time we have fa-
ced into Indian and American problems. It is first time that we have
made endeavour to discuss the colonial question. Our main problem is to
build up parties and trade unions, to command the masses not to liberate
them from the influence of national-reformism; to struggle bitterly
against imperialism and the latter's assistants, the social-democrats.
Acting in cooperation with our allies in the colonies, with the exploited
masses of peasants and colonial slaves, the proletariat will victoriously
conquer in the struggle against imperialism.-

佩珀同志表示，关于广州起义问题的论战并非由他发起，而是由洛米纳泽（Lominadze）同志发起的。共产国际执行委员会第九次全体会议通过的决议，一方面对广州无产阶级的英勇起义给予了应有的赞扬，另一方面批评了那些准备和指挥暴动的人所犯的错误。不能像斯特拉霍夫同志和洛米纳泽同志所做的那样，将中国无产阶级的英勇斗争与中国共产党领导层所犯的错误混为一谈。我们应该揭露广州暴动中犯下的所有错误，以便使我们在未来不仅能组织起义，而且能组织胜利的起义。
继佩珀之后发言的库西宁同志（芬兰）在批评了前面一些发言者的观点后 stating：我们在本次大会上取得了非常显著的成就。这是我们首次直面印度和美国问题。这是我们首次努力讨论殖民地问题。我们的主要问题是建立党和工会，指挥群众，而不是将他们从民族改良主义的影响中解放出来；要同帝国主义及其助手社会民主党人进行激烈的斗争。无产阶级通过与殖民地的盟友、受剥削的农民群众和殖民地奴隶合作，将在反对帝国主义的斗争中取得胜利。-

Moscow, August 22, 1925.

5th CONGRESS OF THE INTERNATIONAL of YOUNG COMMUNISTS.
1st Session.

On August 20 the opening of the 5th Universal International Congress
of the Communist Youth was inaugurated in Moscow. It was opened by an
address delivered by Comrade Hitaroff who said : "When opening Congress
we declare our loyalty to the Comintern and promise in future to be
its faithful soldiers. During those 4 years, which have elapsed since
our last Congress, the International of Young Communists has proved
itself to be a powerful fighting organisation. However our organization
has incorporated so far an insufficient number of labour youths. We have
to consider the question how to develop KIM into a greater mass orga-
nization. We are confident that this problem will be successfully solved.
We shall not indulge in the present session in haranguing about peace as
is being done by the pacifists of all countries. When the time comes how-
ever KIM will show how it can struggle against war".
Comrade Bukharin who was greeted with applause said : "I welcome the
vanguard of the toiling self-sacrifying youths, who are struggling
throughout the world for world revolution. Your congress is being held
at a moment when special unity in the struggle is required from you. A new
generation, which does not know and does not remember the great imperia-
list war now is growing up. The signs of a new war are visible. This danger
is a very real one. To struggle against it KIM should mobilize, in addition
to its own forces, hundreds of thousands or millions of the youthful
toiling masses. Young toilers are everywhere fighting at the front lines.
They must be prepared to divert the imperialist war into a civil one for
the purpose of establishing the dictatorship of the proletariat. The
6th Congress of the Communist International is working in this direction
and the 5th Congress of the International of Young Communists must do the
same. The principal task of the Young Internationals is to struggle, not
by the press alone, but also by sheer strength to overcome the war menace.
KIM will adopt its own programme at its Congress. This programme will serve
as the banner under which the young revolutionaries will combat and score
victories. The main problem of your Congress must be - to discuss the
question of new methods to win over the toiling masses. Representatives
of three generations are present at this sitting i.e. fighters of the
Paris Commune, participants in the October revolution, and representatives
of the new generation whose duty is to build up world communism. The
youthful workers should learn from their elder brethern how to work. It
will be their lot to blow up the capitalist world and establish the
foundation of a strong proletarian dictatorship throughout the world.
On the conclusion of Comrade Bukharin's speech Comrade Hitaroff, the
President, read the text of the military oath approved by Congress. All
delegates and public present arose and repeated after Hitaroff the
words of the oath: " Being loyal to the will of our great leaders, Lenin
and Liebknecht, we swear to mobilize the youthful toilers of the whole
world irreconcilably to struggle against the imperialists of all countries
who are preparing war against U.S.S.R. -the stronghold of the world's
labour class. We swear to be in the first ranks in the struggle for com-
munism and remember the glorious traditions of the young men's Communist
International, so that we will constantly and persistently work that,
when the war breaks out, the soldiers of all countries will be prepared
to take arms for the defense of the Soviet Union, for the defense of the
oppressed peoples, for the overthrow of the bourgeoisie, for the victory

青年共产国际第五次代表大会。
第一次会议。

8月20日，青年共产主义者第五次世界代表大会在莫斯科开幕。希塔罗夫（Hitaroff）同志致开幕词，他说：“在大会开幕之际，我们宣告对共产国际的忠诚，并承诺在未来成为其忠实的战士。自上次大会以来的四年间，青年共产国际已证明自身是一个强大的战斗组织。然而，迄今为止，我们的组织吸纳的劳动青年数量仍显不足。我们必须考虑如何将青年共产国际（KIM）发展为更庞大的群众组织。我们相信这一问题将得到成功解决。在本次会议上，我们不会像各国和平主义者那样沉溺于空谈和平。然而，当时机到来时，青年共产国际将展示其如何与战争作斗争”。

布哈林（Bukharin）同志在掌声中说道：“我向全世界为世界革命而斗争的、勤劳且勇于自我牺牲的青年先锋队致以欢迎。你们的代表大会召开之际，正是要求你们在斗争中实现特别团结的时刻。新一代正在成长，他们不了解也不记得伟大的帝国主义战争。新战争的迹象已可见。这种危险是非常真实的。为了与之斗争，青年共产国际除了动员自身力量外，还应动员数十万乃至数百万的年轻劳动群众。年轻劳动者 everywhere 都在前线战斗。他们必须做好准备，将帝国主义战争转化为内战，以建立无产阶级专政为目的。共产国际第六次代表大会正朝此方向努力，青年共产国际第五次代表大会也必须如此。青年国际的主要任务不仅是通过报刊，还要凭借纯粹的力量去克服战争威胁。青年共产国际将在其代表大会上通过自己的纲领。该纲领将成为年轻革命者进行战斗并取得胜利的旗帜。你们代表大会的主要问题必须是——讨论争取劳动群众的新方法问题。出席本次会议的代表来自三代人，即巴黎公社的战士、十月革命的参与者，以及负有建设世界共产主义使命的新一代代表。青年工人应向他们的兄长们学习如何工作。炸毁资本主义世界并在全球范围内建立稳固的无产阶级专政基础，将是他们的命运。”

布哈林同志讲话结束后，主席希塔罗夫同志宣读了经大会批准的军事誓词全文。所有在场代表及公众起立，跟随希塔罗夫复述誓词：“忠于我们伟大领袖列宁和李卜克内西的意志，我们发誓毫不妥协地动员全世界的年轻劳动者，与所有准备对苏联——世界工人阶级堡垒——发动战争的各国帝国主义者作斗争。我们发誓在争取共产主义的斗争中站在最前列，铭记青年共产国际的光荣传统，以便我们持续不断地努力，使各国士兵在战争爆发时准备好拿起武器，保卫苏维埃联盟，保卫被压迫人民，推翻资产阶级，争取

Activities of the Executive Committee of the Communist Interna-
tional.

The first plenary session of the Executive Committee recently
elected at the 6th Congress of the Communist International was held
on September 3. The following members of the presidium were elected.
Members: Barbe, Bell, Bukharin, Ritlow, Ylek, Kato, Katayama,
Kolaroff, Bela-Koon, Kuusinen, Lozovsky, Manuilsky, Molotoff, Mousseau,
Fruhiack, Piatnitzky, Remmele, Ross, Semard, Serra, Stalin, Telman,
Hitaroff(KIM), Tzetkina Klara, Chilboom, Chiu-Vito, Chmeral, Ember-Dreau,
Ercoli.
Candidates: Foster, Hansen, Gekker, Lensky, Milovitch, Politt,
Poorman, Rust(KIM), Chang Pi Ao.

On September 8 the first sitting of the newly elected Committee
took place. The committee elected the following members to the po-
sition of secretariat:
Members: Barbe, Bell, Bukharin, Kuusinen, Molotoff, Piahnitzky,
Remmele, Serra, Chiu-Vito, Chmeral, Ember-Dreau.
Candidates: Manuilsky, Lozovsky, Hitaroff.

The presidium discussed at this sitting the question of the
situation in the French and Austrian Communist Parties. In the
resolution regarding the policy of the French Communist Party the
Presidium stated, that the results of the election campaign in France
wholly justified the tactics and line of policy agreed upon by the
conference of the French Communist Party in January 1927 and endorsed
by the 9th Plenary of the Executive Committee of the Communist Inter-
national. The above resolution emphasized considerable importance re-
garding the struggle against the war menace, which must continue
to remain "the main spring of the activity of the F.C.P."
The struggle against the war menace and against repressions confronts
the party with the problem of combatting formal legalism.-

W. C. I.

There is no unexplored part of Pamir.
The following telegram has been received from the Pamir Expe-
dition:
Our problem has been solved. The Gorbunoff and Scherbakoff
parties walked along the Tanymas and Bartang passes, crossed over
to Yangulen and mounted the territory to its sources, made a land-
survey, botanical and geological exploration. The group of Krylenko,
Dorofeev and Razmirovitch, having discovered two new passes from
Tanymas into the valley of Bratang, descended along one by one and
crossed into Yangulen where they joined the Gorbunoff group. Both
parties mounted the Yangulen glacier and discovered a new pass into
which is 5.200 metres high, outcropping the Fedchenko glacier. It has
been discovered that the Fedchenko glacier is connected by snow fields
with Yangulen glacier which is 20 mile in length.

我们的问题已解决。戈尔布诺夫（Gorbunoff）和谢尔巴科夫（Scherbakoff）两队沿塔内马斯（Tanymas）和巴尔坦格（Bartang）山口行进，穿越至杨古伦（Yangulen），并溯源地而上，进行了土地测量、植物学和地质学勘探。克雷连科（Krylenko）、多罗费耶夫（Dorofeev）和拉兹米罗维奇（Razmirovitch）小组发现了从塔内马斯进入布拉坦格（Bratang）山谷的两个新山口，依次沿其中一个下降，穿越至杨古伦，并与戈尔布诺夫小组会合。两队均登上了杨古伦冰川，并发现了一个海拔5,200米的新山口，该山口高出费德琴科（Fedchenko）冰川。现已发现，费德琴科冰川通过雪原与长达20英里的杨古伦冰川相连。

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST IN
(39) Session.
The closing of Congress.

To-day's sitting of Congress opened at 9.o'clock and was pre-
sided over by Comrade Remmele. Comrade Bukharin made a report of the
commission's work on the Programme of the Communist International.
After a brief resume of the work performed by the programme commis-
sion Congress unanimously adopted the programme which was accompa-
nied by greetings and applause by all present at Congress. Members
of the Congress rose and sang the "International".

On the proposal submitted by Comrade Amber-Dro, Congress unani-
mously incorporated into its ranks the parties of Korea, Ireland,
New Zealand, Paraguay, Cuba, Columbia and Equador, which countries
were represented at Congress by sympathisers. Comrade Paredes (Equa-
dor) in the name of the newly incorporated parties delivered an
address in which he assured listeners that the new members of the
Comintern will undertake every effort to bolshevize their ranks and
bring about the unification of workers and peasants in their countri-
es under the Comintern banner for cooperation against Imperialism
and colonial oppression and for the defense of U.S.S.R., the
motherland of the world's proletariat.

After the election of members to the Executive Committee
and the International Control Commission, Comrade Remmele declared
that the works of the Universal Congress of the Communist Internatio-
nal were ended and consequently Congress was brought to a close.-

《消息报》
莫斯科，九月

共产国际第六次代表大会
(39) 次会议。
大会闭幕。

今日的大会会议于9点开幕，由雷梅尔（Remmele）同志主持。布哈林同志作了关于共产国际纲领委员会工作的报告。在简要总结纲领委员会所做的工作后，大会一致通过了该纲领，全场与会者报以问候和掌声。大会代表起立高唱《国际歌》。

根据安伯-德罗（Amber-Dro）同志提出的提议，大会一致将朝鲜、爱尔兰、新西兰、巴拉圭、古巴、哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔的政党纳入其行列，这些国家由同情者代表出席大会。帕雷德斯（Paredes）同志（厄瓜多尔）代表新加入的政党发表讲话，他向听众保证，共产国际的新成员将竭尽全力使其队伍布尔什维克化，并在共产国际的旗帜下实现本国工人和农民的联合，以合作反对帝国主义和殖民压迫，并保卫苏联——世界无产阶级的祖国。

在执行委员会和国际监察委员会成员选举结束后，雷梅尔同志宣布，共产国际世界代表大会的工作已结束，因此大会闭幕。-
